# GUPBlazor — complete reference

Version 0.3.4. Every component in one file, for a single fetch.

# GUPHTMLFooter

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/../GUPHTMLFooter.razor`

Emits the scripts GUPBlazor needs. Place just before </body>.

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/../GUPHTMLHeader.razor`

# GUPWizardStack

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GUPWizardStack.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/wizard

Part of the Wizard main & footer component set — see the Wizard main & footer page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
High-level wizard layout: wires GupHeader, GupContentHeader, GupWizardMain (with stepper) and GupWizardFooter. Steps are declared as <GUPWizardStackStep> children and shown one at a time based on CurrentStepIndex.
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ShowHeader` | `bool` | `true` | — |  |
| `NavAriaLabel` | `string` | `"Wizard Navigation Header"` | — |  |
| `ShowContentHeader` | `bool` | `true` | — |  |
| `PageTitle` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — |  |
| `PageSubtitle` | `string?` | — | — |  |
| `ShowStepper` | `bool` | `true` | — |  |
| `StepperOpen` | `bool` | `false` | — | Initial expanded state of the collapsible stepper header. Applied once on first render; the user's own toggling wins from then on. |
| `ShowAllSteps` | `bool` | `false` | — | Read-only mode: render ALL steps' content stacked (no navigation) and wrap it in a disabled <fieldset> so every form control inside is non-editable. Pair with ShowStepper=false and ShowFooter=false for a flat, view-only form. Default off. |
| `StepLabelFormat` | `string` | `"Step {0} of {1}"` | — | Format string for the "Step N of M" progress label shown on the collapsible stepper header. `{0}` is the current step number (1-based), `{1}` is the total number of steps. Pass a translated template (e.g. an Arabic "الخطوة {0} من {1}") to localize it. |
| `StepperAppearance` | `GupDetailsContentAppearance` | `GupDetailsContentAppearance.Sink` | — |  |
| `StepperClosedIcon` | `string` | `"add-circle"` | — |  |
| `StepperOpenIcon` | `string` | `"remove-circle"` | — |  |
| `ShowFooter` | `bool` | `true` | — |  |
| `BackButtonText` | `string` | `"Back"` | — |  |
| `ContinueButtonText` | `string` | `"Continue"` | — |  |
| `CompleteButtonText` | `string` | `"Submit"` | — |  |
| `ShowBackIcon` | `bool` | `true` | — | Show the leading arrow icon on the Back button. Default: true. |
| `ShowContinueIcon` | `bool` | `true` | — | Show the trailing arrow icon on the Continue (non-final) button. Default: true. |
| `ShowCompleteIcon` | `bool` | `true` | — | Show the trailing check icon on the final Submit/Complete button. Default: true. Set false for steps like "Accept and Send" where no arrow/tick is wanted. |
| `ContinueIconName` | `string` | `"arrow-forward"` | — | Icon name for the Continue (non-final) button. Default: "arrow-forward". |
| `CompleteIconName` | `string` | `"check"` | — | Icon name for the final Submit/Complete button. Default: "check". |
| `IsLoading` | `bool` | `false` | — | When true, all footer buttons are disabled (e.g. while an async operation is in flight). Reset to false to re-enable navigation. |
| `CurrentStepIndex` | `int` | `0` | `@bind-CurrentStepIndex` |  |
| `IsRTL` | `bool` | `false` | — |  |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |
| `<HeaderStart>` |  |
| `<HeaderEnd>` |  |
| `<PageSummary>` |  |
| `<ErrorSummary>` | Rendered at the very top of the wizard body, above the stepper, so a validation summary stays in one place regardless of which step is active. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `CurrentStepIndexChanged` | `EventCallback<int>` |  |
| `OnStepChanged` | `EventCallback<int>` |  |
| `OnNext` | `EventCallback<GupWizardNavArgs>` |  |
| `OnBack` | `EventCallback<GupWizardNavArgs>` |  |
| `OnComplete` | `EventCallback<int>` |  |

> Members of `GupWizardNavArgs` are documented in [support types](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SMEDAOman/GUPBlazor/main/docs/ai/types.md).

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### From the ServiceStart page template

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ServiceStart.razor -->
```razor
<GUPWizardStack @ref="_wizard"
                PageTitle="Service name"
                @bind-CurrentStepIndex="_currentStep"
                IsLoading="@_isLoading"
                OnStepChanged="HandleStepChanged"
                PageSubtitle="A brief description of the service, its requirements, or instructions for the user can go here. It can be a couple of sentences long."

               >
    <PageSummary>
        <p>Summary content goes here. It can be a few sentences long and include <strong>formatted text</strong>, links, or other elements.</p>
    </PageSummary>

    <HeaderStart>
        
        <GupTrack Direction="horizontal" Gap="2">
            <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Text" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button" Type="@GupButtonType.Button"
                       OnClick="@(() => Nav.NavigateTo("/"))">
                <IconStart><GupIcon IconName="close" Width="24" Height="24" /></IconStart>
                <ChildContent>Save &amp; exit</ChildContent>
            </GupButton>
        </GupTrack>
    </HeaderStart>

    <HeaderEnd>
        <GupTrack Direction="horizontal" HorizontalAlignment="right" Gap="2">
            <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Text" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button" Type="@GupButtonType.Button"
                       OnClick="@(() => Nav.NavigateTo("/help"))">
                <IconStart><GupIcon IconName="live-help" Width="24" Height="24" /></IconStart>
                <ChildContent><span class="header-action-label">Do you need help?</span></ChildContent>
            </GupButton>
        </GupTrack>
    </HeaderEnd>

    <ChildContent>

        <GUPWizardStackStep Title="Applicant details"
                            Description="Tell us who is applying."
                            NextButtonText="Continue to service details">
            <form>
                <GupFormSection>
                    <Title>Personal information</Title>
                    <ChildContent>
                        <GupFormList>
                            <GupInputField Name="full-name" Type="text">Full name</GupInputField>
                            <GupInputField Name="civil-id" Type="text">Civil ID</GupInputField>
                            <GupInputField Name="email" Type="email">Email</GupInputField>
                        </GupFormList>
                    </ChildContent>
                </GupFormSection>
            </form>
        </GUPWizardStackStep>

        <GUPWizardStackStep Title="Service details"
                            Description="Lock this step to disable Continue."
                            Locked="@_lockServiceDetails"
                            BackButtonText="Edit applicant"
                            OnNext="Handle1"
                            >
            <GupFormSection>
                <Title>Request</Title>
                <ChildContent>
                    <label style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 18px; color: var(--gup-color-content-primary); margin-bottom: 16px;">
                        <input type="checkbox" @bind="_lockServiceDetails" />
                        <span>Lock this step (disables the Continue button)</span>
                    </label>
                    <GupFormList>
                        <GupInputField Name="subject" Type="text">Subject</GupInputField>
                        <GupInputField Name="reference" Type="text">Reference number</GupInputField>
                        <GupInputField Name="notes" Type="text">Additional notes</GupInputField>
                    </GupFormList>
                </ChildContent>
            </GupFormSection>
        </GUPWizardStackStep>

        <GUPWizardStackStep Title="Review"
                            Description="Toggle the option below to demo the per-step OnNext cancel flow."
                            NextButtonText="Submit"
                            OnNext="HandleReviewNext">
            <GupFormSection>
                <Title>Confirm</Title>
                <ChildContent>
                    <label style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 18px; color: var(--gup-color-content-primary);">
                        <input type="checkbox" @bind="_blockSubmit" />
                        <span>Block the next click (step's <code>OnNext</code> will set <code>args.Cancel = true</code>)</span>
                    </label>
                </ChildContent>
            </GupFormSection>
        </GUPWizardStackStep>

        <GUPWizardStackStep Title="Done"
                            Description="Your request has been submitted."
                            NextButtonText="Finish"
                            BackButtonText="Back to review"
                            OnNext="HandleComplete">
            <GupFormSection>
                <Title>Thank you</Title>
                <ChildContent>
                    <p style="font-size: 18px; color: var(--gup-color-content-primary);">
                        Reference <strong>@_submittedReference</strong> — keep this number for your records.
                    </p>
                </ChildContent>
            </GupFormSection>
        </GUPWizardStackStep>

    </ChildContent>

</GUPWizardStack>
```

---

Full component index: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SMEDAOman/GUPBlazor/main/docs/ai/index.md · Start here: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SMEDAOman/GUPBlazor/main/docs/docs


# GUPWizardStackStep

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GUPWizardStackStep.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/wizard

Part of the Wizard main & footer component set — see the Wizard main & footer page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
A single step inside a <GUPWizardStack>. Registers itself with the parent so the stepper and navigation know about it, and renders its ChildContent only when it is the active step.
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Title` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — |  |
| `Description` | `string?` | — | — |  |
| `StepLabel` | `string?` | — | — |  |
| `HideDefaultTitle` | `bool` | `false` | — |  |
| `Locked` | `bool` | `false` | — | When true, the wizard's default Continue/Submit button is disabled and `NextAsync` is blocked while this is the active step. |
| `SoftLockNext` | `bool` | `false` | — | When true, the wizard's default Continue/Submit button renders with the disabled *appearance* (greyed) but stays fully clickable, and navigation is NOT blocked — so pressing it still runs this step's `OnNext` validation, which can surface errors and cancel via `args.Cancel`. Use this instead of `Locked` for "looks disabled until the form is complete, but the user can press it to see what's missing". Ignored when `Locked` is true (a hard lock wins). |
| `NextButtonText` | `string?` | — | — | Overrides the wizard's default text for the forward (Continue/Submit) button while this step is active. |
| `HideNextIcon` | `bool` | `false` | — | When true, the forward (Continue/Submit) button renders no trailing icon while this step is active (e.g. an "Accept and Send" step that should have no arrow or tick). |
| `NextIconName` | `string?` | — | — | Overrides the forward (Continue/Submit) button's icon name while this step is active. Takes precedence over the wizard-level icon. Ignored when `HideNextIcon` is true. |
| `BackButtonText` | `string?` | — | — | Overrides the wizard's default text for the Back button while this step is active. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `OnNext` | `EventCallback<GupWizardNavArgs>` | Step-level Next handler. Fires before the wizard-level `OnNext`; set `args.Cancel = true` to abort navigation. |

> Members of `GupWizardNavArgs` are documented in [support types](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SMEDAOman/GUPBlazor/main/docs/ai/types.md).

## Cascading values consumed

- Parent

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### From the ServiceStart page template

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ServiceStart.razor -->
```razor
<GUPWizardStackStep Title="Applicant details"
                            Description="Tell us who is applying."
                            NextButtonText="Continue to service details">
            <form>
                <GupFormSection>
                    <Title>Personal information</Title>
                    <ChildContent>
                        <GupFormList>
                            <GupInputField Name="full-name" Type="text">Full name</GupInputField>
                            <GupInputField Name="civil-id" Type="text">Civil ID</GupInputField>
                            <GupInputField Name="email" Type="email">Email</GupInputField>
                        </GupFormList>
                    </ChildContent>
                </GupFormSection>
            </form>
        </GUPWizardStackStep>
```

### From the ServiceStart page template

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ServiceStart.razor -->
```razor
<GUPWizardStackStep Title="Service details"
                            Description="Lock this step to disable Continue."
                            Locked="@_lockServiceDetails"
                            BackButtonText="Edit applicant"
                            OnNext="Handle1"
                            >
            <GupFormSection>
                <Title>Request</Title>
                <ChildContent>
                    <label style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 18px; color: var(--gup-color-content-primary); margin-bottom: 16px;">
                        <input type="checkbox" @bind="_lockServiceDetails" />
                        <span>Lock this step (disables the Continue button)</span>
                    </label>
                    <GupFormList>
                        <GupInputField Name="subject" Type="text">Subject</GupInputField>
                        <GupInputField Name="reference" Type="text">Reference number</GupInputField>
                        <GupInputField Name="notes" Type="text">Additional notes</GupInputField>
                    </GupFormList>
                </ChildContent>
            </GupFormSection>
        </GUPWizardStackStep>
```

# GupAccordion

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupAccordion.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/accordion

Collapsible sections, single or multiple open, including item actions.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-accordion> A wrapper for accordion items. Default slot: ChildContent (only GupAccordionItem elements expected)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Default

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Accordion.razor -->
```razor
<GupAccordion>
    <GupAccordionItem>
        <LabelContent>Click me</LabelContent>
        <ChildContent>Some hidden content</ChildContent>
    </GupAccordionItem>
    <GupAccordionItem>
        <LabelContent>Click me too</LabelContent>
        <ChildContent>Some other hidden content</ChildContent>
    </GupAccordionItem>
    <GupAccordionItem>
        <LabelContent>Slip merely pocket large no copy</LabelContent>
        <ChildContent>Some hidden content</ChildContent>
    </GupAccordionItem>
    <GupAccordionItem>
        <LabelContent>Crop copy ate accept anything leather fifty</LabelContent>
        <ChildContent>Some hidden content</ChildContent>
    </GupAccordionItem>
</GupAccordion>
```

### Open by default

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Accordion.razor -->
```razor
<GupAccordion>
    <GupAccordionItem Open="true">
        <LabelContent>I am open by default</LabelContent>
        <ChildContent>I am an accordion item</ChildContent>
    </GupAccordionItem>
    <GupAccordionItem>
        <LabelContent>I am closed by default</LabelContent>
        <ChildContent>I am an accordion item</ChildContent>
    </GupAccordionItem>
</GupAccordion>
```

### Ontoggle event

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Accordion.razor -->
```razor
<GupAccordion>
    <GupAccordionItem OnToggle="HandleAccordionToggled">
        <LabelContent>Watch the event log</LabelContent>
        <ChildContent>Each open/close emits an OnToggle event with the new open state.</ChildContent>
    </GupAccordionItem>
</GupAccordion>
<p data-testid="event-log" style="margin-top: 12px;">
    Last event: <strong>@_lastEvent</strong> (count: @_eventCount)
</p>
```

### Hide show hide controls

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Accordion.razor -->
```razor
<GupAccordion>
    <GupAccordionItem HideControls="true">
        <LabelContent>No controls — click anywhere on the label</LabelContent>
        <ChildContent>The Show / Hide indicator is suppressed.</ChildContent>
    </GupAccordionItem>
    <GupAccordionItem HideControls="true">
        <LabelContent>Another bare item</LabelContent>
        <ChildContent>Useful for very dense layouts.</ChildContent>
    </GupAccordionItem>
</GupAccordion>
```

### Custom show hide labels i18n

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Accordion.razor -->
```razor
<GupAccordion>
    <GupAccordionItem LabelShow="عرض" LabelHide="اخفاء">
        <LabelContent>اضغط</LabelContent>
        <ChildContent>محتوى مخفي</ChildContent>
    </GupAccordionItem>
    <GupAccordionItem LabelShow="Open" LabelHide="Close">
        <LabelContent>English with custom labels</LabelContent>
        <ChildContent>The action labels can be localized.</ChildContent>
    </GupAccordionItem>
</GupAccordion>
```

### Two way binding bind open

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Accordion.razor -->
```razor
<GupTrack Direction="horizontal" Gap="2">
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary"
               Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _bindOpen = !_bindOpen)">
        <ChildContent>Toggle externally</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
</GupTrack>

<div style="margin-top: 16px;">
    <GupAccordion>
        <GupAccordionItem @bind-Open="_bindOpen">
            <LabelContent>Bound accordion item</LabelContent>
            <ChildContent>The Open state is bound to a parent property — the button above can toggle it too.</ChildContent>
        </GupAccordionItem>
    </GupAccordion>
</div>

<p data-testid="bind-output" style="margin-top: 12px;">
    Bound value: <strong>@(_bindOpen ? "open" : "closed")</strong>
</p>
```

---

Full component index: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SMEDAOman/GUPBlazor/main/docs/ai/index.md · Start here: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SMEDAOman/GUPBlazor/main/docs/docs


# GupAccordionItem

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupAccordionItem.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/accordion

Part of the Accordion component set — see the Accordion page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-accordion-item open hide-controls label-show="..." label-hide="..."> Two-way binding: @bind-Open Events: OnToggle (new open state) Slots: LabelContent (named "label"), ChildContent (default — collapsible content)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LabelShow` | `string` | `"Show"` | — | A translatable label for the Show indicator. |
| `LabelHide` | `string` | `"Hide"` | — | A translatable label for the Hide indicator. |
| `Open` | `bool` | — | `@bind-Open` | Whether the accordion item is open. |
| `HideControls` | `bool` | — | — | Whether to hide the show/hide controls. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<LabelContent>` |  |
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `OpenChanged` | `EventCallback<bool>` | Two-way binding callback for Open. |
| `OnToggle` | `EventCallback<bool>` | Fires whenever the item is toggled by the user. Argument is the new open state. |

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Standalone item no wrapper

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Accordion.razor -->
```razor
<GupAccordionItem>
    <LabelContent>I am alone</LabelContent>
    <ChildContent>An accordion item can be used outside a GupAccordion wrapper.</ChildContent>
</GupAccordionItem>
```

### Default

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Accordion.razor -->
```razor
<GupAccordion>
    <GupAccordionItem>
        <LabelContent>Click me</LabelContent>
        <ChildContent>Some hidden content</ChildContent>
    </GupAccordionItem>
    <GupAccordionItem>
        <LabelContent>Click me too</LabelContent>
        <ChildContent>Some other hidden content</ChildContent>
    </GupAccordionItem>
    <GupAccordionItem>
        <LabelContent>Slip merely pocket large no copy</LabelContent>
        <ChildContent>Some hidden content</ChildContent>
    </GupAccordionItem>
    <GupAccordionItem>
        <LabelContent>Crop copy ate accept anything leather fifty</LabelContent>
        <ChildContent>Some hidden content</ChildContent>
    </GupAccordionItem>
</GupAccordion>
```

### Open by default

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Accordion.razor -->
```razor
<GupAccordion>
    <GupAccordionItem Open="true">
        <LabelContent>I am open by default</LabelContent>
        <ChildContent>I am an accordion item</ChildContent>
    </GupAccordionItem>
    <GupAccordionItem>
        <LabelContent>I am closed by default</LabelContent>
        <ChildContent>I am an accordion item</ChildContent>
    </GupAccordionItem>
</GupAccordion>
```

### Ontoggle event

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Accordion.razor -->

```razor
</GupAccordion>
<p data-testid="event-log" style="margin-top: 12px;">
    Last event: <strong>@_lastEvent</strong> (count: @_eventCount)
```

```razor
    <GupAccordionItem LabelShow="عرض" LabelHide="اخفاء">
        <LabelContent>اضغط</LabelContent>
        <ChildContent>محتوى مخفي</ChildContent>
    </GupAccordionItem>
```

### Two way binding bind open

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Accordion.razor -->
```razor
<GupTrack Direction="horizontal" Gap="2">
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary"
               Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _bindOpen = !_bindOpen)">
        <ChildContent>Toggle externally</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
</GupTrack>

<div style="margin-top: 16px;">
    <GupAccordion>
        <GupAccordionItem @bind-Open="_bindOpen">
            <LabelContent>Bound accordion item</LabelContent>
            <ChildContent>The Open state is bound to a parent property — the button above can toggle it too.</ChildContent>
        </GupAccordionItem>
    </GupAccordion>
</div>

<p data-testid="bind-output" style="margin-top: 12px;">
    Bound value: <strong>@(_bindOpen ? "open" : "closed")</strong>
</p>
```

---

# GupAvatar

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupAvatar.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/avatar

User avatar from initials or an image.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-avatar size="s|m|l" src="..." alt="..." label="..." status="..."> Renders a user avatar — image when Src+Alt are provided, name abbreviation when Label is provided, otherwise a generic "person" icon. Supports an optional status badge in the bottom-end corner. Two-way binding: @bind-Status, @bind-Label, @bind-Src Events: OnClick
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Size` | `GupAvatarSize` | `GupAvatarSize.S` | — | Avatar size — small, medium, or large. |
| `Src` | `string?` | — | `@bind-Src` | Image source — when set together with `Alt`, the avatar shows the image. |
| `Alt` | `string?` | — | — | Image alt text. Required for the image to render. |
| `Label` | `string?` | — | `@bind-Label` | Text label — uppercase letters are extracted as the abbreviation when no image is provided. |
| `Status` | `GupBadgeType?` | — | `@bind-Status` | Optional status badge rendered in the bottom-end corner. |
| `StatusAriaLabel` | `string?` | — | — | Accessible label for the status badge. |
| `AriaLabel` | `string?` | — | — | Accessible label for the avatar itself. |

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SrcChanged` | `EventCallback<string?>` |  |
| `LabelChanged` | `EventCallback<string?>` |  |
| `StatusChanged` | `EventCallback<GupBadgeType?>` |  |
| `OnClick` | `EventCallback<MouseEventArgs>` | Fires when the avatar is clicked or activated by keyboard (Enter/Space). |

> Members of `GupBadgeType` are documented in [support types](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SMEDAOman/GUPBlazor/main/docs/ai/types.md).

## Enums

### `GupAvatarSize`

- `GupAvatarSize.S`
- `GupAvatarSize.M`
- `GupAvatarSize.L`

### Large


# GupBadge

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupBadge.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/badges

Status badges in the full colour range.


## Import


## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Type` | `GupBadgeType` | `GupBadgeType.Neutral` | — |  |
| `AriaLabel` | `string?` | — | — |  |

## Enums

### `GupBadgeType`

- `GupBadgeType.Neutral`
- `GupBadgeType.Positive`
- `GupBadgeType.Negative`
- `GupBadgeType.Offline`

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### In a summary layout

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../LabelledItem.razor -->
```razor
<GupLabelledItem Label="Service">Commercial licence renewal</GupLabelledItem>
<GupLabelledItem Label="Reference">OM-2026-4471</GupLabelledItem>
<GupLabelledItem Label="Status">
  <GupBadge Type="GupBadgeType.Positive" />
  Approved
</GupLabelledItem>
```

### With status badges

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../TableCellDemo.razor -->
```razor
<GupTable>
  <GupTableRow>
    <GupTableCell Type="header">Reference</GupTableCell>
    <GupTableCell Type="header">Status</GupTableCell>
  </GupTableRow>
  <GupTableRow>
    <GupTableCell>OM-2026-4471</GupTableCell>
    <GupTableCell><GupBadge Type="GupBadgeType.Positive" /> Approved</GupTableCell>
  </GupTableRow>
  <GupTableRow>
    <GupTableCell>OM-2026-4473</GupTableCell>
    <GupTableCell><GupBadge Type="GupBadgeType.Negative" /> Rejected</GupTableCell>
  </GupTableRow>
</GupTable>
```

### Toggle

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ReadOnlyCascade.razor -->
```razor
<GupTrack Direction="horizontal" Gap="3">
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary" OnClick="ToggleReadOnly">
        <ChildContent>@(_readOnly ? "Unlock the form" : "Lock the form")</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    @* GupBadge is a status dot; the label sits beside it. *@
    <GupTrack Direction="horizontal" Gap="2" VerticalAlignment="center">
        <GupBadge Type="@(_readOnly ? GupBadgeType.Negative : GupBadgeType.Positive)"
                  AriaLabel="@(_readOnly ? "Locked" : "Editable")" />
        <span>@(_readOnly ? "Locked" : "Editable")</span>
    </GupTrack>
</GupTrack>

<p style="margin-top:16px;">
    Producers: wrap a region in <code>&lt;CascadingValue Value="flag" Name="GupReadOnly"&gt;</code>,
    or use <code>&lt;GupReadOnlyRegion ReadOnly="flag"&gt;</code>, which cascades the same
    value and additionally blocks pointer events for markup that is not built
    from these components.
</p>

<h3 style="margin-top:16px;">What to check when locked</h3>
<ul>
    <li>Typing into any text field, textarea or number field does nothing.</li>
    <li>The dropdown does not open; the checkbox and radios do not change.</li>
    <li>The file picker is gone entirely, not merely greyed out.</li>
    <li>Tabbing through the form skips the inputs instead of landing on them.</li>
    <li>No "This field is required" appears on an empty locked field.</li>
    <li>The date and password affix buttons are disabled, not just inert.</li>
</ul>
```

# GupBanner

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupBanner.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/banner

Page-level messages in four severities, outline and filled appearances.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-banner type="neutral|success|warning|error" appearance="outline|filled" hide-icon show-close-button> Named slots: TitleContent (upstream's Title), ChildContent (body), ActionButtons (typically two GupButtons) Events: OnClose (fires when the close button is clicked — matches gup-close)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Type` | `GupBannerType` | `GupBannerType.Neutral` | — | Status of the banner. Default: `neutral`. |
| `Appearance` | `GupBannerAppearance` | `GupBannerAppearance.Outline` | — | Visual style — outline (default) or filled. |
| `HideIcon` | `bool` | — | — | Hide the leading status icon. Default: false. |
| `ShowCloseButton` | `bool` | — | — | Display the close button. Default: false (matches the design-system default). |
| `CloseLabel` | `string` | `"Close"` | — | Accessible label for the close button. Only relevant if `ShowCloseButton` is true. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<TitleContent>` |  |
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |
| `<ActionButtons>` | Slot for (typically two) `GupButton` action buttons — matches the action-buttons slot. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `OnClose` | `EventCallback` | Fires when the close button is clicked (matches the `gup-close` event). |

## Enums

### `GupBannerType`

Status of a `GupBanner`. Mirrors the `type` attribute on the gov.om `<gup-banner>` design-system component.

- `GupBannerType.Neutral` — Neutral / informational banner (default).
- `GupBannerType.Success` — Success banner.
- `GupBannerType.Warning` — Warning banner.
- `GupBannerType.Error` — Error banner.

### `GupBannerAppearance`

Visual style of a `GupBanner`. Mirrors the `appearance` attribute on the gov.om `<gup-banner>` design-system component.

- `GupBannerAppearance.Outline` — Outlined banner (default).
- `GupBannerAppearance.Filled` — Filled (strong background) banner.

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Severities

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Banner.razor -->
```razor
<GupBanner Type="GupBannerType.Neutral">
  <TitleContent>Neutral</TitleContent>
  <ChildContent>Your application has been saved as a draft.</ChildContent>
</GupBanner>
<GupBanner Type="GupBannerType.Success">
  <TitleContent>Success</TitleContent>
  <ChildContent>Your changes have been saved.</ChildContent>
</GupBanner>
<GupBanner Type="GupBannerType.Warning">
  <TitleContent>Warning</TitleContent>
  <ChildContent>Your session will expire in five minutes.</ChildContent>
</GupBanner>
<GupBanner Type="GupBannerType.Error">
  <TitleContent>Error</TitleContent>
  <ChildContent>We could not process your request. Please try again.</ChildContent>
</GupBanner>
```

### Filled appearance

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Banner.razor -->
```razor
<GupBanner Type="GupBannerType.Success" Appearance="GupBannerAppearance.Filled">
  <TitleContent>Submitted</TitleContent>
  <ChildContent>Reference number OM-2026-4471.</ChildContent>
</GupBanner>
<GupBanner Type="GupBannerType.Error" Appearance="GupBannerAppearance.Filled">
  <TitleContent>Payment failed</TitleContent>
  <ChildContent>The card was declined by the issuing bank.</ChildContent>
</GupBanner>
```

### Without an icon

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Banner.razor -->
```razor
<GupBanner Type="GupBannerType.Neutral" HideIcon="true">
  <ChildContent>A plain message with no leading icon.</ChildContent>
</GupBanner>
```

### With actions

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Banner.razor -->
```razor
<GupBanner Type="GupBannerType.Warning">
  <TitleContent>Unsaved changes</TitleContent>
  <ChildContent>You have changes that have not been submitted yet.</ChildContent>
  <ActionButtons>
    <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Primary">Save now</GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Text">Discard</GupButton>
  </ActionButtons>
</GupBanner>
```

# GupBreadcrumbs

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupBreadcrumbs.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/breadcrumbs

Trail with current-item state; collapses to first and last below 599px.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-breadcrumbs> A wrapper for breadcrumb items. Default slot: ChildContent (only GupBreadcrumbsItem elements expected)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AriaLabel` | `string` | `"Breadcrumb"` | — | Accessible label for the breadcrumb trail. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Default

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Breadcrumbs.razor -->
```razor
<GupBreadcrumbs>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#">Home</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#">Store</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#">Category</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#">Phone</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#" Current="true">Phone specs</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
</GupBreadcrumbs>
```

### Two items

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Breadcrumbs.razor -->
```razor
<GupBreadcrumbs>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#">Representative of an Overseas Business visa</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#" Current="true">Settling in Oman</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
</GupBreadcrumbs>
```

### Onclick event

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Breadcrumbs.razor -->
```razor
<GupBreadcrumbs>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="javascript:void(0)" OnClick="@(e => Log("Home"))">Home</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="javascript:void(0)" OnClick="@(e => Log("Store"))">Store</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="javascript:void(0)" OnClick="@(e => Log("Category"))">Category</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="javascript:void(0)" Current="true" OnClick="@(e => Log("Phone specs"))">Phone specs</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
</GupBreadcrumbs>

<p data-testid="event-log" style="margin-top:12px;">
    Last clicked: <strong>@_lastClicked</strong> (count: @_clickCount)
</p>
```

### Rtl arabic

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Breadcrumbs.razor -->
```razor
<GupBreadcrumbs AriaLabel="مسار التنقل">
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#">الصفحة الرئيسية</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#" Current="true">هذه الصفحة</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
</GupBreadcrumbs>
```

### Two way binding bind current

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Breadcrumbs.razor -->
```razor
@* IsMultiline: three fixed-width buttons overflow a 360px viewport otherwise. *@
<GupTrack Direction="horizontal" Gap="2" IsMultiline="true">
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary"
               Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _currentIndex = 0)">
        <ChildContent>Mark Home as current</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary"
               Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _currentIndex = 1)">
        <ChildContent>Mark Store as current</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary"
               Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _currentIndex = 2)">
        <ChildContent>Mark Category as current</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
</GupTrack>

<div style="margin-top:16px;">
    <GupBreadcrumbs>
        <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#" @bind-Current="_isHomeCurrent">Home</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
        <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#" @bind-Current="_isStoreCurrent">Store</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
        <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#" @bind-Current="_isCategoryCurrent">Category</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    </GupBreadcrumbs>
</div>

<p data-testid="bind-output" style="margin-top:12px;">
    Current item: <strong>@CurrentLabel</strong>
</p>
```

### With breadcrumbs

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ContentHeaderDemo.razor -->
```razor
<GupContentHeader PageTitle="Apply for a licence">
  <Breadcrumbs>
    <GupBreadcrumbs>
      <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="/">Home</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
      <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="/demo/forms">Services</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
      <GupBreadcrumbsItem Current="true">Apply</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    </GupBreadcrumbs>
  </Breadcrumbs>
  <PageSummary>Breadcrumbs sit above the title.</PageSummary>
</GupContentHeader>
```

# GupBreadcrumbsItem

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupBreadcrumbsItem.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/breadcrumbs

Part of the Breadcrumbs component set — see the Breadcrumbs page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-breadcrumbs-item href="..." current> A single breadcrumb item — to be used as a child of GupBreadcrumbs. Two-way binding: @bind-Current, @bind-Href Events: OnClick
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Href` | `string` | `"#"` | `@bind-Href` | Breadcrumb URL. |
| `Current` | `bool` | — | `@bind-Current` | Whether this breadcrumb represents the current page. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `HrefChanged` | `EventCallback<string>` |  |
| `CurrentChanged` | `EventCallback<bool>` |  |
| `OnClick` | `EventCallback<MouseEventArgs>` | Fires when the breadcrumb link is clicked. |

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Default

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Breadcrumbs.razor -->
```razor
<GupBreadcrumbs>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#">Home</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#">Store</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#">Category</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#">Phone</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#" Current="true">Phone specs</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
</GupBreadcrumbs>
```

### Two items

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Breadcrumbs.razor -->
```razor
<GupBreadcrumbs>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#">Representative of an Overseas Business visa</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#" Current="true">Settling in Oman</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
</GupBreadcrumbs>
```

### Onclick event

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Breadcrumbs.razor -->
```razor
<GupBreadcrumbs>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="javascript:void(0)" OnClick="@(e => Log("Home"))">Home</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="javascript:void(0)" OnClick="@(e => Log("Store"))">Store</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="javascript:void(0)" OnClick="@(e => Log("Category"))">Category</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="javascript:void(0)" Current="true" OnClick="@(e => Log("Phone specs"))">Phone specs</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
</GupBreadcrumbs>

<p data-testid="event-log" style="margin-top:12px;">
    Last clicked: <strong>@_lastClicked</strong> (count: @_clickCount)
</p>
```

### Rtl arabic

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Breadcrumbs.razor -->
```razor
<GupBreadcrumbs AriaLabel="مسار التنقل">
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#">الصفحة الرئيسية</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="#" Current="true">هذه الصفحة</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
</GupBreadcrumbs>
```

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ContentHeaderDemo.razor -->

### Two way binding bind current

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Breadcrumbs.razor -->
```razor
@* IsMultiline: three fixed-width buttons overflow a 360px viewport otherwise. *@
<GupTrack Direction="horizontal" Gap="2" IsMultiline="true">
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary"
               Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"

    </GupButton>

               Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _currentIndex = 1)">
        <ChildContent>Mark Store as current</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
```

# GupButton

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupButton.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/buttons

Button appearances, icons, disabled states, and button groups.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-button appearance="primary|secondary|text|danger" kind="button|link" ...> Named slots: IconStart, IconEnd Default slot: ChildContent (button label)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Appearance` | `GupButtonAppearance` | `GupButtonAppearance.Primary` | — |  |
| `Kind` | `GupButtonKind` | `GupButtonKind.Button` | — |  |
| `Type` | `GupButtonType` | `GupButtonType.Button` | — |  |
| `Href` | `string?` | — | — |  |
| `Disabled` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `SoftDisabled` | `bool` | — | — | Renders the button with the disabled *appearance* (greyed) while keeping it fully interactive — the click still fires. Use for "looks disabled until the form is valid, but pressing it reveals what's missing" affordances. Ignored when `Disabled` is true (a real disable wins). |
| `WithIconOnly` | `bool` | — | — | Display only the icon with no text label (matches `with-icon-only`). Provide `Label` for the accessible name. |
| `Inverted` | `bool` | — | — | Whether the button is inverted (for dark backgrounds). |
| `Label` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — | Accessible label used when `WithIconOnly` is true. |
| `OpenInNewTab` | `bool` | — | — | Open the URL in a new tab. Only applicable when `Kind` is Link. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |
| `<IconStart>` |  |
| `<IconEnd>` |  |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `OnClick` | `EventCallback<MouseEventArgs>` |  |

## Enums

### `GupButtonAppearance`

Visual style of a `GupButton`.

- `GupButtonAppearance.Primary`
- `GupButtonAppearance.Secondary`
- `GupButtonAppearance.Text`
- `GupButtonAppearance.Danger`

### `GupButtonKind`

Whether a `GupButton` renders as a button or an anchor.

- `GupButtonKind.Button`
- `GupButtonKind.Link`

### `GupButtonType`

The HTML `type` attribute of a `GupButton`.

- `GupButtonType.Button`
- `GupButtonType.Submit`
- `GupButtonType.Reset`

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Appearances

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Buttons.razor -->
```razor
<GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary" OnClick="ButtonClicked">Primary</GupButton>
<GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" OnClick="ButtonClicked">Secondary</GupButton>
<GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Text" OnClick="ButtonClicked">Text</GupButton>
<GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Danger" OnClick="ButtonClicked">Danger</GupButton>
```

### With icons

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Buttons.razor -->
```razor
<GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary" OnClick="ButtonClicked">
  <IconStart><GupIcon IconName="arrow-back" Width="20" Height="20" /></IconStart>
  <ChildContent>Icon Start</ChildContent>
</GupButton>
<GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary" OnClick="ButtonClicked">
  <ChildContent>Icon End</ChildContent>
  <IconEnd><GupIcon IconName="arrow-forward" Width="20" Height="20" /></IconEnd>
</GupButton>
<GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" OnClick="ButtonClicked">
  <IconStart><GupIcon IconName="close" Width="20" Height="20" /></IconStart>
  <ChildContent>Cancel</ChildContent>
</GupButton>
<GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Text" OnClick="ButtonClicked">
  <IconStart><GupIcon IconName="live-help" Width="20" Height="20" /></IconStart>
  <ChildContent>Need help?</ChildContent>
</GupButton>
```

### Disabled state

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Buttons.razor -->
```razor
<GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary" Disabled="true" OnClick="ButtonClicked">Primary disabled</GupButton>
<GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Disabled="true" OnClick="ButtonClicked">Secondary disabled</GupButton>
<GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Text" Disabled="true" OnClick="ButtonClicked">Text disabled</GupButton>
<GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary" Disabled="true" OnClick="ButtonClicked">
  <ChildContent>Disabled with icon</ChildContent>
  <IconEnd><GupIcon IconName="arrow-forward" Width="20" Height="20" /></IconEnd>
</GupButton>
```

### Kind=link (renders as <a>)

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Buttons.razor -->
```razor
<GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Link" Href="#" OnClick="ButtonClicked">Link Primary</GupButton>
<GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Link" Href="#" OnClick="ButtonClicked">Link Secondary</GupButton>
<GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Text" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Link"  OnClick="ButtonClicked">Link Text</GupButton>
```

### Button Group

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Buttons.razor -->
```razor
<GupButtonGroup>
  <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary" OnClick="ButtonClicked">Submit Application</GupButton>
  <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" OnClick="ButtonClicked">Save Draft</GupButton>
  <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Text" OnClick="ButtonClicked">Cancel</GupButton>
</GupButtonGroup>
```

### Horizontal default

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ButtonGroup.razor -->
```razor

  <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Primary">Continue</GupButton>
  <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Secondary">Save as draft</GupButton>
  <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Text">Cancel</GupButton>
</GupButtonGroup>
```

### Vertical

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ButtonGroup.razor -->
```razor

  <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Primary">Continue</GupButton>
  <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Secondary">Save as draft</GupButton>
  <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Text">Cancel</GupButton>
</GupButtonGroup>
```

### With icons

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ButtonGroup.razor -->
```razor
<GupButtonGroup>
  <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Secondary">
    <IconStart><GupIcon IconName="arrow-back" Width="20" Height="20" /></IconStart>
    <ChildContent>Back</ChildContent>
  </GupButton>
  <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Primary">
    <ChildContent>Continue</ChildContent>
    <IconEnd><GupIcon IconName="arrow-forward" Width="20" Height="20" /></IconEnd>
  </GupButton>
</GupButtonGroup>
```

# GupButtonGroup

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupButtonGroup.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/button-group

Groups of related buttons, with the stacking behaviour used on mobile.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-button-group direction="horizontal|vertical|vertical-on-mobile|vertical-reverse-on-mobile"> Wraps gup-button elements with a gap.
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Direction` | `string` | `"horizontal"` | — | Direction of the button group. One of horizontal (default), vertical, vertical-on-mobile, vertical-reverse-on-mobile. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Horizontal default

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ButtonGroup.razor -->
```razor
<GupButtonGroup>
  <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Primary">Continue</GupButton>
  <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Secondary">Save as draft</GupButton>
  <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Text">Cancel</GupButton>
</GupButtonGroup>
```

### Vertical

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ButtonGroup.razor -->
```razor
<GupButtonGroup Direction="vertical">
  <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Primary">Continue</GupButton>
  <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Secondary">Save as draft</GupButton>
  <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Text">Cancel</GupButton>
</GupButtonGroup>
```

### With icons

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ButtonGroup.razor -->
```razor
<GupButtonGroup>
  <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Secondary">
    <IconStart><GupIcon IconName="arrow-back" Width="20" Height="20" /></IconStart>
    <ChildContent>Back</ChildContent>
  </GupButton>
  <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Primary">
    <ChildContent>Continue</ChildContent>
    <IconEnd><GupIcon IconName="arrow-forward" Width="20" Height="20" /></IconEnd>
  </GupButton>
</GupButtonGroup>
```

### Button Group

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Buttons.razor -->
```razor
<GupButtonGroup>
  <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary" OnClick="ButtonClicked">Submit Application</GupButton>
  <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" OnClick="ButtonClicked">Save Draft</GupButton>
  <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Text" OnClick="ButtonClicked">Cancel</GupButton>
</GupButtonGroup>
```

### Onactionclick event

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../PageStatus.razor -->
```razor
<GupPageStatus Type="GupPageStatusType.Success"
               PageTitle="All set."
               OnActionClick="HandleActionClick">
    <ChildContent>Click any of the action buttons below.</ChildContent>
    <ActionContent>
        <GupButtonGroup>
            <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button">
                <ChildContent>Continue</ChildContent>
            </GupButton>
            <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button">
                <ChildContent>View receipt</ChildContent>
            </GupButton>
        </GupButtonGroup>
    </ActionContent>
</GupPageStatus>

<p data-testid="event-log" style="margin:0; text-align:center;">
    Action clicks: <strong>@_actionClickCount</strong>
</p>
```

### With footer action buttons

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FormSection.razor -->
```razor
<GupFormSection>
    <Title>Contact details</Title>
    <ChildContent>
        <GupFormList>
            <GupInputField Name="footer-email" Type="email">Email</GupInputField>
            <GupInputField Name="footer-phone" Type="tel">Mobile number</GupInputField>
        </GupFormList>
    </ChildContent>
    <FooterContent>
        <GupButtonGroup>
            <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary"
                       Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
                       OnClick="HandleSave">
                <ChildContent>Save</ChildContent>
            </GupButton>
            <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary"
                       Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
                       OnClick="HandleCancel">
                <ChildContent>Cancel</ChildContent>
            </GupButton>
        </GupButtonGroup>
    </FooterContent>
</GupFormSection>

<p data-testid="footer-log" style="margin: 8px 0 0;">
    Last footer action: <strong>@_lastFooterAction</strong>
</p>
```

### Rtl arabic

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FormSection.razor -->
```razor
<GupFormSection>
    <Title>المعلومات الشخصية</Title>
    <ChildContent>
        <GupFormList>
            <GupInputField Name="rtl-first-name" Type="text">الاسم الأول</GupInputField>
            <GupInputField Name="rtl-last-name" Type="text">اسم العائلة</GupInputField>
        </GupFormList>
    </ChildContent>
    <FooterContent>
        <GupButtonGroup>
            <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary"
                       Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button">
                <ChildContent>حفظ</ChildContent>
            </GupButton>
            <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary"
                       Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button">
                <ChildContent>إلغاء</ChildContent>
            </GupButton>
        </GupButtonGroup>
    </FooterContent>
</GupFormSection>
```

### Onfooterclick event

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FormSection.razor -->
```razor
<div data-testid="footer-click-section">
<GupFormSection OnFooterClick="HandleFooterAreaClick">
    <Title>Footer click delegation</Title>
    <ChildContent>
        <p style="margin: 0; color: var(--gup-color-content-primary);">
            Click any of the buttons below — the parent component logs the click.
        </p>
    </ChildContent>
    <FooterContent>
        <GupButtonGroup>
            <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary"
                       Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button">
                <ChildContent>Action 1</ChildContent>
            </GupButton>
            <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary"
                       Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button">
                <ChildContent>Action 2</ChildContent>
            </GupButton>
            <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Text"
                       Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button">
                <ChildContent>Action 3</ChildContent>
            </GupButton>
        </GupButtonGroup>
    </FooterContent>
</GupFormSection>
</div>

<p data-testid="footer-click-log" style="margin:0;">
    Footer area clicks: <strong>@_footerClickCount</strong>
</p>
```

# GupCallout

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupCallout.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/callout

Block quote with optional author, in three appearances.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-callout appearance="default|background|border"> A callout / blockquote with an optional title and footer (e.g. an author name). Slots: - TitleContent  → rendered as a heading next to a quote icon (header) - ChildContent  → main body of the callout (default slot) - FooterContent → optional footer (e.g. attribution) Two-way binding: @bind-Appearance Events: OnClick
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Appearance` | `GupCalloutAppearance` | `GupCalloutAppearance.Default` | `@bind-Appearance` | Visual appearance — default (left border), background (filled), or border (outlined). |
| `AriaLabel` | `string?` | — | — | Accessible label for the callout — used when the callout is clickable. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<TitleContent>` | Optional title — rendered next to a quote icon. |
| `<ChildContent>` | Main body of the callout. |
| `<FooterContent>` | Optional footer — typically an author or attribution. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `AppearanceChanged` | `EventCallback<GupCalloutAppearance>` |  |
| `OnClick` | `EventCallback<MouseEventArgs>` | Fires when the callout is clicked or activated by keyboard (Enter/Space). |

## Enums

### `GupCalloutAppearance`

- `GupCalloutAppearance.Default`
- `GupCalloutAppearance.Background`
- `GupCalloutAppearance.Border`

## Examples

### Default (left border)

```razor
    <TitleContent>Quote title</TitleContent>
    <ChildContent>It is a long established fact that a reader will be distracted by the readable
        content of a page when looking at its layout.</ChildContent>
    <FooterContent>- Author</FooterContent>

```

### Background (filled)

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Callout.razor -->

```razor
    <ChildContent>It is a long established fact that a reader will be distracted by the readable
        content of a page when looking at its layout.</ChildContent>
    <FooterContent>- Author</FooterContent>
</GupCallout>
```

### Border (outlined)

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Callout.razor -->
```razor
<GupCallout Appearance="@GupCalloutAppearance.Border">
    <TitleContent>Quote title</TitleContent>
    <ChildContent>It is a long established fact that a reader will be distracted by the readable
        content of a page when looking at its layout.</ChildContent>

</GupCallout>
```

### Attribution

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Flag.razor -->
```razor

    Flag artwork comes from the
    <a href="https://github.com/lipis/flag-icons">flag-icons</a> project,
    MIT licensed. The licence ships with the package at
    <code>_content/GUPBlazor/flags/LICENSE.txt</code>.
</GupCallout>
```

### Accessibility

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../SkipLink.razor -->
```razor
<GupCallout>
    The link is hidden with the <code>screenreader-text</code> clip pattern
    rather than <code>display:none</code>, so it stays in the focus order and
    in the accessibility tree. Never hide it in a way that removes it from
    the tab sequence.
</GupCallout>
```

# GupContentHeader

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupContentHeader.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/content-header

Page title, summary and optional actions at the top of a page.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-content-header page-title="..." page-subtitle="..."> Slots: Breadcrumbs, PageSubtitleContent, PageTitleContent, PageSummary, ChildContent (content below title) The *Content slots take precedence over the corresponding string props.
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PageTitle` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — | Page title. Used when the PageTitleContent slot is not provided. |
| `PageSubtitle` | `string?` | — | — | Page subtitle (above the title). Used when the PageSubtitleContent slot is not provided. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<Breadcrumbs>` | Slot for gup-breadcrumbs. Do not insert anything else here. |
| `<PageTitleContent>` | Slot for the page title. Takes precedence over the PageTitle prop. |
| `<PageSubtitleContent>` | Slot for the page subtitle. Takes precedence over the PageSubtitle prop. |
| `<PageSummary>` | Slot for textual content appearing below the title. |
| `<ChildContent>` | Default slot — content below the title. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Title only

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ContentHeaderDemo.razor -->
```razor
<GupContentHeader PageTitle="Apply for a licence" />
```

### With a summary

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ContentHeaderDemo.razor -->
```razor
<GupContentHeader PageTitle="Apply for a licence">
  <PageSummary>
    Complete all sections before submitting. You can save a draft and return later.
  </PageSummary>
</GupContentHeader>
```

### With a subtitle

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ContentHeaderDemo.razor -->
```razor
<GupContentHeader PageTitle="Apply for a licence" PageSubtitle="Step 2 of 4" />
```

### With breadcrumbs

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ContentHeaderDemo.razor -->
```razor
<GupContentHeader PageTitle="Apply for a licence">
  <Breadcrumbs>
    <GupBreadcrumbs>
      <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="/">Home</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
      <GupBreadcrumbsItem Href="/demo/forms">Services</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
      <GupBreadcrumbsItem Current="true">Apply</GupBreadcrumbsItem>
    </GupBreadcrumbs>
  </Breadcrumbs>
  <PageSummary>Breadcrumbs sit above the title.</PageSummary>
</GupContentHeader>
```

# GupDataSheet

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupDataSheet.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/data-sheet

Bordered card grouping labelled items — order summaries and similar.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-data-sheet> A bordered, padded container — typically used to highlight a group of GupLabelledItem entries (e.g. an order summary), but it can wrap any other content too. Slots: - ChildContent → the content of the data-sheet (default slot) Events: OnClick (also makes the sheet keyboard-focusable / activatable)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AriaLabel` | `string?` | — | — | Accessible label for the sheet — used when the sheet is clickable. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Content of the data-sheet (typically GupLabelledItem children). |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `OnClick` | `EventCallback<MouseEventArgs>` | Fires when the sheet is clicked or activated by keyboard (Enter/Space). |

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Default any content

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../DataSheet.razor -->
```razor
<GupDataSheet>
    <ChildContent>
        Usually this component is used with labelled items, but it can be also used to highlight
        any other content.
    </ChildContent>
</GupDataSheet>
```

### With labelled items

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../DataSheet.razor -->
```razor
<GupDataSheet>
    <ChildContent>
        <GupLabelledItem Label="Selected service">
            <ChildContent>Service name</ChildContent>
        </GupLabelledItem>
        <GupLabelledItem Label="Amount to pay">
            <IconContent>
                <GupIcon IconName="receipt" Width="30" Height="30" />
            </IconContent>
            <ChildContent>15 OMR</ChildContent>
        </GupLabelledItem>
    </ChildContent>
</GupDataSheet>
```

### Rich label content

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../DataSheet.razor -->
```razor
<GupDataSheet>
    <ChildContent>
        <GupLabelledItem>
            <LabelContent>
                <span style="display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
                    <GupIcon IconName="badge" Width="16" Height="16" /> Applicant ID
                </span>
            </LabelContent>
            <ChildContent>OM-2026-001234</ChildContent>
        </GupLabelledItem>
        <GupLabelledItem>
            <LabelContent>
                <span style="display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
                    <GupIcon IconName="event" Width="16" Height="16" /> Submitted on
                </span>
            </LabelContent>
            <ChildContent>5 May 2026</ChildContent>
        </GupLabelledItem>
    </ChildContent>
</GupDataSheet>
```

### Click events

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../DataSheet.razor -->
```razor
<GupDataSheet AriaLabel="Order summary"
              OnClick="HandleSheetClick">
    <ChildContent>
        <GupLabelledItem Label="Service"
                         AriaLabel="Edit service"
                         OnClick="HandleItemClick">
            <ChildContent>Click me — labelled item</ChildContent>
        </GupLabelledItem>
        <GupLabelledItem Label="Total">
            <ChildContent>Click outside any item — bubbles to the sheet</ChildContent>
        </GupLabelledItem>
    </ChildContent>
</GupDataSheet>

<p data-testid="click-log" style="margin:0;">
    Sheet clicks: <strong data-testid="sheet-clicks">@_sheetClicks</strong> ·
    Item clicks: <strong data-testid="item-clicks">@_itemClicks</strong>
</p>
```

### Rtl arabic

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../DataSheet.razor -->
```razor
<GupDataSheet>
    <ChildContent>
        <GupLabelledItem Label="الخدمة المختارة">
            <ChildContent>اسم الخدمة</ChildContent>
        </GupLabelledItem>
        <GupLabelledItem Label="المبلغ المستحق">
            <IconContent>
                <GupIcon IconName="receipt" Width="30" Height="30" />
            </IconContent>
            <ChildContent>١٥ ر.ع</ChildContent>
        </GupLabelledItem>
    </ChildContent>
</GupDataSheet>
```

### Two way binding bind label

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../DataSheet.razor -->
```razor
<input data-testid="bind-input"
       type="text"
       value="@_boundLabel"
       @oninput="OnBoundLabelInput"
       style="padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid var(--gup-color-border-low); border-radius:8px;" />

<GupDataSheet>
    <ChildContent>
        <GupLabelledItem @bind-Label="_boundLabel">
            <ChildContent>Bound value renders here.</ChildContent>
        </GupLabelledItem>
    </ChildContent>
</GupDataSheet>

<p data-testid="bind-output" style="margin:0;">
    Bound label: <strong>@_boundLabel</strong>
</p>
```

# GupDataTable

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupDataTable.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/data-table

Table chrome around GupTable — search, filter panel with removable chips, empty state, pagination footer.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-data-table title="..." description="..." show-search show-filters ...> Composite table chrome: header, search box, filter panel, applied-filter chips, empty state and a pagination footer wrapped around <GupTable>. Two modes, selected by whether Items is set: - Data-driven (Items != null): the component searches, slices and renders rows itself via RowTemplate. This is the only mode where the search box filters. - Manual (Items == null): the consumer supplies ChildContent rows already paged; the component renders chrome only and reports page/search changes via events. Two-way binding: @bind-SearchValue, @bind-CurrentPage, @bind-ResultsCount, @bind-FilterPanelOpen, @bind-AppliedFilters Events: OnSearch, OnPageChange, OnClearFilters, OnViewClick, OnFilterApply
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TableTitle` | `string?` | — | — | Heading shown above the table. Named `TableTitle` rather than `Title` to avoid colliding with the HTML `title` attribute. |
| `Description` | `string?` | — | — | Supporting text shown beneath `TableTitle`. |
| `SearchPlaceholder` | `string` | `"Find data"` | — | Placeholder for the search box. Also used as its accessible label. |
| `SearchValue` | `string?` | — | `@bind-SearchValue` | Current search term. |
| `ResultsCount` | `int?` | — | `@bind-ResultsCount` | Match count rendered as "N results" beside the search box. Null hides the label. |
| `TotalItems` | `int` | — | — | Unfiltered row count across all pages. Drives the item counter, the page count and the empty state, so a data-driven consumer must set it (typically `Items.Count()`) — it is not inferred from `Items`. Zero renders the empty state. The component never writes to it: while a search is active the chrome narrows to the match count internally, so this stays the consumer's own total. |
| `CurrentPage` | `int` | `1` | `@bind-CurrentPage` | Active page, 1-based. |
| `ItemsPerPage` | `int` | `10` | — | Rows per page. Values of zero or less fall back to 10. |
| `ShowSearch` | `bool` | `true` | — | Whether the search box is rendered. |
| `ShowFilters` | `bool` | — | — | Whether the filter button, filter panel and view button are rendered. |
| `Filters` | `IReadOnlyList<GupDataTableFilter>` | `[]` | — | Filters offered in the filter panel. |
| `AppliedFilters` | `IReadOnlyList<GupAppliedFilter>` | `[]` | `@bind-AppliedFilters` | Filters the user has applied, rendered as removable chips. |
| `Columns` | `IReadOnlyList<GupDataTableColumn>` | `[]` | — | Column definitions. When non-empty a header row is rendered from them, and each column's `Width` or `Grow` sizes it. |
| `FiltersButtonText` | `string` | `"Filters"` | — | Label for the filter toggle, in both the desktop and mobile control stacks. |
| `ClearAllText` | `string` | `"Clear all"` | — | Label for the button that clears every applied-filter chip. |
| `ViewButtonText` | `string` | `"View application"` | — | Label for the secondary action button beside the filter toggle. |
| `ViewButtonIcon` | `string?` | — | — | Icon name shown before `ViewButtonText`. Null renders no icon. |
| `ShowViewButton` | `bool` | `true` | — | Whether the view button is rendered. |
| `MobileActionButtons` | `IReadOnlyList<string>` | `[]` | — | Labels for extra full-width action buttons shown above the mobile filter toggle. |
| `EmptyTitle` | `string` | `"No applications found"` | — | Heading of the empty state. |
| `EmptyDescription` | `string` | `"There are no applications to display. Create your first application to get started."` | — | Body text of the empty state. |
| `FilterPanelOpen` | `bool` | — | `@bind-FilterPanelOpen` | Whether the filter panel is open. |
| `Responsive` | `bool` | `true` | — | Passed to the inner `GupTable`: collapses rows into stacked cards below the mobile breakpoint. Replaces the `layout` property of the Lit component. |
| `Items` | `IEnumerable<TItem>?` | — | — | Rows to display. When set, the component performs its own search, filtering and paging. |
| `SearchTextSelector` | `Func<TItem, string>?` | — | — |  |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<RowTemplate>` | Renders one row. Receives the item for that row. |
| `<ChildContent>` | Rows supplied directly by the consumer, used when `Items` is null. In that mode the consumer owns searching and paging — the search box only raises `OnSearch`, and the pagination footer only raises `OnPageChange`. |
| `<FiltersContent>` | Replaces the auto-generated filter editors in both filter panels. |
| `<PaginationContent>` | Replaces the built-in `GupPagination` in the footer. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SearchValueChanged` | `EventCallback<string?>` | Fires when `SearchValue` changes — enables `@@bind-SearchValue`. |
| `ResultsCountChanged` | `EventCallback<int?>` | Fires when `ResultsCount` changes — enables `@@bind-ResultsCount`. |
| `CurrentPageChanged` | `EventCallback<int>` | Fires when `CurrentPage` changes — enables `@@bind-CurrentPage`. |
| `AppliedFiltersChanged` | `EventCallback<IReadOnlyList<GupAppliedFilter>>` | Fires when `AppliedFilters` changes — enables `@@bind-AppliedFilters`. |
| `FilterPanelOpenChanged` | `EventCallback<bool>` | Fires when `FilterPanelOpen` changes — enables `@@bind-FilterPanelOpen`. |
| `OnSearch` | `EventCallback<string?>` | Fires on every keystroke in the search box, with the new term. |
| `OnPageChange` | `EventCallback<int>` | Fires when the page changes, with the new page number. |
| `OnClearFilters` | `EventCallback` | Fires when Clear is pressed in the filter panel or the chip row. |
| `OnViewClick` | `EventCallback` | Fires when the view button is pressed. |
| `OnFilterApply` | `EventCallback<IReadOnlyList<GupAppliedFilter>>` | Fires when Apply is pressed in the filter panel, with the applied filters. |
| `OnMobileActionClick` | `EventCallback<string>` | Fires when one of the `MobileActionButtons` is pressed, with its label. |

> Members of `GupAppliedFilter` are documented in [support types](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SMEDAOman/GUPBlazor/main/docs/ai/types.md).

## Enums

### `GupDataTableFilterType`

Kind of editor rendered for a filter in the filter panel.

- `GupDataTableFilterType.Text` — Free-text input.
- `GupDataTableFilterType.Date` — Date picker input.
- `GupDataTableFilterType.Select` — Dropdown populated from `Options`.

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Default search and pagination

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../DataTable.razor -->
```razor
<GupDataTable Items="Applications"
              SearchTextSelector="SearchText"
              TableTitle="Applications"
              Description="This is a short description"
              Columns="ApplicationColumns"
              ItemsPerPage="6"
              TotalItems="Applications.Count"
              @bind-SearchValue="_defaultSearch"
              @bind-CurrentPage="_defaultPage"
              @bind-ResultsCount="_defaultResults"
              ShowFilters="false">
    <RowTemplate Context="app">
        <GupTableRow>
            <GupTableCell Label="Number">@app.Number</GupTableCell>
            <GupTableCell Label="Type">@app.Type</GupTableCell>
            <GupTableCell Label="Start date">@app.StartDate</GupTableCell>
            <GupTableCell Label="End date">@app.EndDate</GupTableCell>
            <GupTableCell Label="Status">
                <GupBadgeChip Appearance="@app.StatusAppearance">@app.Status</GupBadgeChip>
            </GupTableCell>
        </GupTableRow>
    </RowTemplate>
</GupDataTable>
```

### With filters text date and select

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../DataTable.razor -->
```razor
<GupDataTable Items="Applications"
              SearchTextSelector="SearchText"
              TableTitle="Applications"
              Description="Filter by status, reference or date"
              Columns="ApplicationColumns"
              ItemsPerPage="6"
              TotalItems="Applications.Count"
              ShowFilters="true"
              ViewButtonText="Action"
              ViewButtonIcon="download"
              Filters="ApplicationFilters"
              MobileActionButtons="@(new[] { "New application" })"
              @bind-SearchValue="_filterSearch"
              @bind-CurrentPage="_filterPage"
              @bind-ResultsCount="_filterResults"
              @bind-FilterPanelOpen="_filterPanelOpen"
              @bind-AppliedFilters="_appliedFilters"
              OnFilterApply="HandleFilterApply"
              OnClearFilters="@(() => Log("Clear filters"))"
              OnViewClick="@(() => Log("View click"))"
              OnMobileActionClick="@(label => Log($"Mobile action: {label}"))">
    <RowTemplate Context="app">
        <GupTableRow>
            <GupTableCell Label="Number">@app.Number</GupTableCell>
            <GupTableCell Label="Type">@app.Type</GupTableCell>
            <GupTableCell Label="Start date">@app.StartDate</GupTableCell>
            <GupTableCell Label="End date">@app.EndDate</GupTableCell>
            <GupTableCell Label="Status">
                <GupBadgeChip Appearance="@app.StatusAppearance">@app.Status</GupBadgeChip>
            </GupTableCell>
        </GupTableRow>
    </RowTemplate>
</GupDataTable>

<p data-testid="filter-log" style="margin:16px 0 0; padding:0 24px 16px;">
    Last event: <strong>@_lastEvent</strong>
    &nbsp;·&nbsp; applied: <strong>@_appliedFilters.Count</strong>
</p>
```

### Empty state

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../DataTable.razor -->
```razor
<GupDataTable TItem="Application"
              Items="NoApplications"
              TableTitle="Applications"
              Description="This is a short description"
              Columns="ApplicationColumns"
              ItemsPerPage="6"
              TotalItems="0"
              ShowFilters="true"
              ViewButtonText="Action"
              Filters="ApplicationFilters"
              @bind-FilterPanelOpen="_emptyPanelOpen" />
```

### Search only

```razor
<GupDataTable Items="Applications"
              SearchTextSelector="SearchText"
              SearchPlaceholder="Search applications"
              Columns="ApplicationColumns"

              @bind-CurrentPage="_searchOnlyPage"
```

### Responsive stacked cards below 639px
