# GupDetails

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupDetails.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/details

Single disclosure with quote, sink and none appearances.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-details open content-appearance="quote|sink|none" closed-icon="..." open-icon="..." icon-hidden toggle-button-title="..." close-button-label="..."> A disclosure element. Click on the button, and hidden content will be revealed. Do not stack. Two-way binding: @bind-Open Events: OnToggle (new open state) Slots: LabelContent (named "label"), ChildContent (default — collapsible content)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Open` | `bool` | — | `@bind-Open` | Whether the content is expanded. |
| `ContentAppearance` | `GupDetailsContentAppearance` | `GupDetailsContentAppearance.Quote` | — | Whether the content is styled as a quote, a sink, or none. |
| `ClosedIcon` | `string` | `"keyboard-arrow-down"` | — | The icon to use when the content is closed. |
| `OpenIcon` | `string` | `"keyboard-arrow-up"` | — | The icon to use when the content is open. |
| `ToggleButtonTitle` | `string?` | — | — | A tooltip appearing when hovering on the toggle button. |
| `IconHidden` | `bool` | — | — | Hide the disclosure icon next to the label. |
| `CloseButtonLabel` | `string` | `"Close"` | — | Label/tooltip for the close button (sink appearance only). |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<LabelContent>` |  |
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `OpenChanged` | `EventCallback<bool>` | Two-way binding callback for Open. |
| `OnToggle` | `EventCallback<bool>` | Fires whenever the disclosure is toggled by the user. Argument is the new open state. |

## Enums

### `GupDetailsContentAppearance`

- `GupDetailsContentAppearance.Quote`
- `GupDetailsContentAppearance.Sink`
- `GupDetailsContentAppearance.None`

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Quote (default)

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Details.razor -->
```razor
<GupDetails Open="true" ContentAppearance="@GupDetailsContentAppearance.Quote">
    <LabelContent>Quote appearance</LabelContent>
    <ChildContent>It is a long established fact that a reader will be distracted by the readable
        content of a page when looking at its layout.</ChildContent>
</GupDetails>
```

### Sink

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Details.razor -->
```razor
<GupDetails Open="true" ContentAppearance="@GupDetailsContentAppearance.Sink">
    <LabelContent>Sink appearance</LabelContent>
    <ChildContent>It is a long established fact that a reader will be distracted by the readable
        content of a page when looking at its layout.</ChildContent>
</GupDetails>
```

### None

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Details.razor -->
```razor
<GupDetails Open="true" ContentAppearance="@GupDetailsContentAppearance.None">
    <LabelContent>No decoration</LabelContent>
    <ChildContent>It is a long established fact that a reader will be distracted by the readable
        content of a page when looking at its layout.</ChildContent>
</GupDetails>
```

# GupDialog

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupDialog.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/dialogs

Modal in five sizes including fullscreen, with action buttons.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-dialog heading="..." hide-close-button close-label="..."> A modal dialog. Slots: ChildContent  — main body content ActionButtons — typically a <GupButtonGroup> with Submit/Cancel buttons Visibility is controlled by IsOpen. When IsOpen is true the host renders a full-viewport backdrop + the centered modal panel. ESC closes the dialog (unless HideCloseButton is true). OnClose fires when the close button is clicked, the backdrop is clicked, or ESC is pressed.
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `IsOpen` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `Heading` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — |  |
| `HideCloseButton` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `CloseLabel` | `string` | `"Close"` | — |  |
| `CloseOnBackdropClick` | `bool` | `true` | — |  |
| `Size` | `string` | `"medium"` | — | Dialog width: `small`, `medium` (default), `large`, `xl` or `fullscreen`. An unrecognised value falls back to medium. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |
| `<ActionButtons>` |  |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `OnClose` | `EventCallback` |  |

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### From the Dialogs page template

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Dialogs.razor -->
```razor
<GupDialog Heading="Do you want to save your progress?"
           IsOpen="_defaultOpen"
           OnClose="@(() => CloseDialog("default"))">
  <ChildContent>Save now to keep any changes you've made so far.</ChildContent>
  <ActionButtons>
    <GupButtonGroup>
      <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" OnClick="@(() => CloseDialog("default-submit"))">
        <ChildContent>Submit</ChildContent>
      </GupButton>
      <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Text" OnClick="@(() => CloseDialog("default-cancel"))">
        <ChildContent>Cancel</ChildContent>
      </GupButton>
    </GupButtonGroup>
  </ActionButtons>
</GupDialog>
```

### From the Dialogs page template

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Dialogs.razor -->
```razor
<GupDialog Heading="Dialog with Long Content"
           IsOpen="_longOpen"
           OnClose="@(() => CloseDialog("long"))">
  <ChildContent>
    <p>This is a paragraph with a lot of content to demonstrate scrolling.</p>
    <p>Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Donec euismod, nisl eget ultricies ultricies, nunc nisl ultricies nunc, quis ultricies nunc nisl quis nisl.</p>
    <p>Donec euismod, nisl eget ultricies ultricies, nunc nisl ultricies nunc, quis ultricies nunc nisl quis nisl.</p>
    <p>Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Donec euismod, nisl eget ultricies ultricies, nunc nisl ultricies nunc, quis ultricies nunc nisl quis nisl.</p>
    <p>Donec euismod, nisl eget ultricies ultricies, nunc nisl ultricies nunc, quis ultricies nunc nisl quis nisl.</p>
    <p>Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Donec euismod, nisl eget ultricies ultricies, nunc nisl ultricies nunc, quis ultricies nunc nisl quis nisl.</p>
    <p>Donec euismod, nisl eget ultricies ultricies, nunc nisl ultricies nunc, quis ultricies nunc nisl quis nisl.</p>
  </ChildContent>
  <ActionButtons>
    <GupButtonGroup>
      <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" OnClick="@(() => CloseDialog("long-ok"))">
        <ChildContent>Got it</ChildContent>
      </GupButton>
      <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Text" OnClick="@(() => CloseDialog("long-cancel"))">
        <ChildContent>Cancel</ChildContent>
      </GupButton>
    </GupButtonGroup>
  </ActionButtons>
</GupDialog>
```

# GupDivider

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupDivider.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/divider

Horizontal and vertical rules with spacing options.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-divider appearance="default|secondary|inverse" location="bottom|top|top-and-bottom" gap="4"> A simple divider that separates content via a top, bottom, or both border. The content goes in ChildContent (default slot). Two-way binding: @bind-Appearance, @bind-Location, @bind-Gap Events: OnClick (fires when the divider wrapper is clicked / activated by Enter/Space)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Appearance` | `GupDividerAppearance` | `GupDividerAppearance.Default` | `@bind-Appearance` | Visual appearance — default, secondary (lower contrast), or inverse (for dark surfaces). |
| `Location` | `GupDividerLocation` | `GupDividerLocation.Bottom` | `@bind-Location` | Where the divider line is rendered relative to the content. |
| `Gap` | `int` | `4` | `@bind-Gap` | Spacing (in --unit multiples, default 4 = 16px) between the content and the line. |
| `AriaLabel` | `string?` | — | — | Accessible label — used when the divider is clickable. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Content to be separated by the divider. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `AppearanceChanged` | `EventCallback<GupDividerAppearance>` |  |
| `LocationChanged` | `EventCallback<GupDividerLocation>` |  |
| `GapChanged` | `EventCallback<int>` |  |
| `OnClick` | `EventCallback<MouseEventArgs>` | Fires when the divider is clicked or activated by keyboard (Enter/Space). |

## Enums

### `GupDividerAppearance`

Visual style of a `GupDivider`.

- `GupDividerAppearance.Default`
- `GupDividerAppearance.Secondary`
- `GupDividerAppearance.Inverse`

### `GupDividerLocation`

Which edges of the content a `GupDivider` draws on.

- `GupDividerLocation.Bottom`
- `GupDividerLocation.Top`
- `GupDividerLocation.TopAndBottom`

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Default bottom

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Divider.razor -->
```razor
<GupDivider>
    <span>Element 1</span>
    <span>Element 2 with some words</span>
    <span>Element 3 with so many words that they wrap onto multiple lines and demonstrate how the
        divider sits beneath them.</span>
</GupDivider>
```

### Top

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Divider.razor -->
```razor
<GupDivider Location="@GupDividerLocation.Top" Gap="5">
    <span>Element 1</span>
    <span>Element 2 with some words</span>
    <span>Element 3 with so many words that they wrap.</span>
</GupDivider>
```

### Top and bottom

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Divider.razor -->
```razor
<GupDivider Location="@GupDividerLocation.TopAndBottom" Gap="6">
    <span>Element 1</span>
    <span>Element 2 with some words</span>
    <span>Element 3 with so many words that they wrap onto multiple lines.</span>
</GupDivider>
```

### Secondary appearance

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Divider.razor -->
```razor
<GupDivider Appearance="@GupDividerAppearance.Secondary"
            Location="@GupDividerLocation.TopAndBottom"
            Gap="7">
    <span>Element 1</span>
    <span>Element 2 with some words</span>
    <span>Element 3 — lower-contrast line for less visual weight.</span>
</GupDivider>
```

### Inverse appearance dark surface

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Divider.razor -->
```razor
<GupDivider Appearance="@GupDividerAppearance.Inverse"
            Location="@GupDividerLocation.TopAndBottom"
            Gap="8">
    <span>Element 1</span>
    <span>Element 2 with some words</span>
    <span>Element 3 — white-tinted line on a dark surface.</span>
</GupDivider>
```

### Gap variations

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Divider.razor -->
```razor
<GupDivider Gap="2">
    <span>Gap = 2 (8px)</span>
</GupDivider>
<GupDivider Gap="4">
    <span>Gap = 4 (16px, default)</span>
</GupDivider>
<GupDivider Gap="10">
    <span>Gap = 10 (40px)</span>
</GupDivider>
```

### Two way binding bind appearance bind location bind gap

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Divider.razor -->
```razor
<GupDivider @bind-Appearance="_boundAppearance"
            @bind-Location="_boundLocation"
            @bind-Gap="_boundGap">
    <span>Bound divider</span>
    <span>Use the controls below to change appearance, location, and gap.</span>
</GupDivider>

<div style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center;">
    <strong>Appearance:</strong>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundAppearance = GupDividerAppearance.Default)">
        <ChildContent>Default</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundAppearance = GupDividerAppearance.Secondary)">
        <ChildContent>Secondary</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
</div>

<div style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center;">
    <strong>Location:</strong>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundLocation = GupDividerLocation.Bottom)">
        <ChildContent>Bottom</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundLocation = GupDividerLocation.Top)">
        <ChildContent>Top</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundLocation = GupDividerLocation.TopAndBottom)">
        <ChildContent>Top &amp; bottom</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
</div>

<div style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center;">
    <strong>Gap:</strong>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundGap = Math.Max(0, _boundGap - 1))">
        <ChildContent>−</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundGap = _boundGap + 1)">
        <ChildContent>+</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
</div>

<p data-testid="bind-output" style="margin:0;">
    Bound state: appearance = <strong>@_boundAppearance</strong>, location =
    <strong>@_boundLocation</strong>, gap = <strong>@_boundGap</strong>
</p>
```

### Onclick event

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Divider.razor -->
```razor
<GupDivider Location="@GupDividerLocation.TopAndBottom"
            AriaLabel="Activate the divider"
            OnClick="HandleDividerClick">
    <span>Clickable divider</span>
    <span>Click anywhere in this content (or focus and press Enter/Space) to fire the OnClick
        event.</span>
</GupDivider>

<p data-testid="click-log" style="margin:0;">
    Click count: <strong>@_clickCount</strong>
</p>
```

# GupDropdownField

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupDropdownField.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/inputs/dropdown

Part of the Dropdown component set — see the Dropdown page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-dropdown-field name="..." placeholder="..." required disabled clearable loading> Named slots: Label, Hint Default slot: ChildContent (gup-dropdown-menu) Uses plain JS for interactivity; event handling round-trips to Blazor via DotNetObjectReference. Events: - OnChange (single mode): fires with selected value when user picks an item - OnMultiChange (multi mode): fires on every toggle with current selected values - OnMultiApplied (multi mode): fires when user clicks Apply or closes the menu - OnOpen / OnClose: menu visibility changes - OnClear: clear button clicked
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Name` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — |  |
| `Placeholder` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — |  |
| `Disabled` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `Required` | `bool` | `true` | — |  |
| `IsInvalid` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `Loading` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `Clearable` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `ErrorMessage` | `string?` | — | — |  |
| `DisplayValue` | `string?` | — | — |  |
| `ClearLabel` | `string` | `"Clear"` | — |  |
| `LoadingLabel` | `string` | `"Loading..."` | — |  |
| `MultipleValuesLabel` | `string` | `" selected"` | — |  |
| `LabelHidden` | `bool` | — | — | Hide the label visually while keeping it available to screen-readers (matches `label-hidden`). |
| `Attachment` | `string` | `"bottom-start"` | — | Positioning of the menu relative to the field (matches `attachment`), e.g. bottom-start, top-end. |
| `Value` | `string?` | — | `@bind-Value` |  |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<Label>` |  |
| `<Hint>` |  |
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ValueChanged` | `EventCallback<string?>` |  |
| `OnChange` | `EventCallback<string?>` | Single-select: fires with the selected value (or null) when the user picks an item. |
| `OnMultiChange` | `EventCallback<IReadOnlyList<string>>` | Multi-select: fires on every toggle with the current list of selected values. |
| `OnMultiApplied` | `EventCallback<IReadOnlyList<string>>` | Multi-select: fires when the user clicks Apply or closes the dropdown. |
| `OnOpen` | `EventCallback` |  |
| `OnClose` | `EventCallback` |  |
| `OnClear` | `EventCallback` |  |
| `OnInvalid` | `EventCallback` | Fires when the field fails validation (matches `gup-invalid`). |

## Cascading values consumed

- CascadedReadOnly (cascading name: "GupReadOnly")
- CascadedLangId (cascading name: "GupLangId")

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Single select

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Forms.razor -->
```razor
<GupDropdownField Name="governorate" Placeholder="Select a governorate">
    <Label>Governorate</Label>
    <ChildContent>
        <GupDropdownMenu>
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Muscat" Value="muscat" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Dhofar" Value="dhofar" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Musandam" Value="musandam" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Al Buraimi" Value="buraimi" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Ad Dakhiliyah" Value="dakhiliyah" />
        </GupDropdownMenu>
    </ChildContent>
</GupDropdownField>
```

### With hint pre selected

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Forms.razor -->
```razor

    <Label>Document type</Label>
    <ChildContent>
        <GupDropdownMenu>
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="National ID" Value="national-id" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Passport" Value="passport" Selected="true" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Driving License" Value="driving-license" />
        </GupDropdownMenu>
    </ChildContent>
    <Hint>Choose the type of document to upload.</Hint>
</GupDropdownField>
```

### With search

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Forms.razor -->
```razor
<GupDropdownField Name="country" Placeholder="Search and select">
    <Label>Country</Label>
    <ChildContent>
        <GupDropdownMenu SearchEnabled="true">
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Oman" Value="oman" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="United Arab Emirates" Value="uae" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Saudi Arabia" Value="saudi-arabia" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Bahrain" Value="bahrain" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Kuwait" Value="kuwait" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Qatar" Value="qatar" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Jordan" Value="jordan" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Egypt" Value="egypt" />

            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="United Kingdom" Value="uk" />

    </ChildContent>
</GupDropdownField>
```

# GupDropdownMenu

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupDropdownMenu.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/inputs/dropdown

Part of the Dropdown component set — see the Dropdown page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-dropdown-menu search-enabled multiple>
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SearchEnabled` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `Multiple` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `AriaLabel` | `string` | `"Options"` | — |  |
| `NoItemsLabel` | `string` | `"No items"` | — |  |
| `SearchNoResultsLabel` | `string` | `"No results for"` | — |  |
| `SearchPlaceholder` | `string` | `"Search..."` | — |  |
| `ItemsSelectedButtonLabel` | `string` | `"Apply"` | — |  |
| `NoSelectionButtonLabel` | `string` | `"Done"` | — |  |
| `DoneButtonText` | `string?` | — | — | Label for the dropdown's confirm/close button in its default (no-selection) state. Convenience alias for `NoSelectionButtonLabel` — set either one; if both are set, this takes precedence. Pass a localized value (e.g. via LanguageHub) to relabel "Done". |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### With search

```razor
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="United Arab Emirates" Value="uae" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Saudi Arabia" Value="saudi-arabia" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Bahrain" Value="bahrain" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Kuwait" Value="kuwait" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Qatar" Value="qatar" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Jordan" Value="jordan" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Egypt" Value="egypt" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="India" Value="india" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="Pakistan" Value="pakistan" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="United Kingdom" Value="uk" />
            <GupDropdownMenuItem Label="United States" Value="us" />
        </GupDropdownMenu>
    </ChildContent>
</GupDropdownField>
```

# GupDropdownMenuItem

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupDropdownMenuItem.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/inputs/dropdown

Part of the Dropdown component set — see the Dropdown page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-dropdown-menu-item label="..." value="..." selected disabled>
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Label` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — |  |
| `Value` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — |  |
| `Selected` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `Disabled` | `bool` | — | — |  |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Cascading values consumed

- IsMultiple (cascading name: "IsMultiple")

# GupFileItem

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupFileItem.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/file-item

A single uploaded file row with size, link and remove action.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-file-item file-name="..." subtitle="..." url="..." thumbnail-src="..." thumbnail-alt="..."> Default slot: ChildContent (action button)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FileName` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — |  |
| `Subtitle` | `string?` | — | — |  |
| `Url` | `string?` | — | — |  |
| `ThumbnailSrc` | `string?` | — | — |  |
| `ThumbnailAlt` | `string?` | — | — |  |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Basic

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FileItem.razor -->
```razor
<GupFileItem FileName="lease-agreement.pdf" Subtitle="12.10.2026, 2 MB" />
<GupFileItem FileName="commercial-registration.pdf" Subtitle="12.10.2026, 840 KB" />
```

### As a link

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FileItem.razor -->
```razor
<GupFileItem FileName="receipt.pdf" Subtitle="12.10.2026, 310 KB" Url="/demo/file-item" />
```

### Default

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FileUpload.razor -->
```razor
<GupFileItem FileName="file.png" Subtitle="09.02.2021, 2 MB"
             ThumbnailSrc="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAoAAAAKCAYAAACNMs+9AAAAFUlEQVR42mP8z8BQz0AEYBxVSF+FABJADveWkH6oAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC"
             ThumbnailAlt="Thumbnail" />
```

### With download link

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FileUpload.razor -->
```razor
<GupFileItem FileName="designers-card.png" Subtitle="09.02.2021, 2 MB"
             Url="https://example.com/documents/designers-card.png"
             ThumbnailSrc="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAoAAAAKCAYAAACNMs+9AAAAFUlEQVR42mP8z8BQz0AEYBxVSF+FABJADveWkH6oAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC"
             ThumbnailAlt="Thumbnail" />
```

### With delete icon button

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FileUpload.razor -->
```razor
<GupFileItem FileName="file.png" Subtitle="09.02.2021, 2 MB"
             ThumbnailSrc="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAoAAAAKCAYAAACNMs+9AAAAFUlEQVR42mP8z8BQz0AEYBxVSF+FABJADveWkH6oAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC"
             ThumbnailAlt="Thumbnail">
    <div class="gup-button gup-button--text">
        <button type="button" class="button" aria-label="Remove the file"
                title="Remove the file" @onclick="@(() => Alert("Delete clicked"))">
            <GupIcon IconName="delete-forever" Width="24" Height="24" />
        </button>
    </div>
</GupFileItem>
```

### Multiple items grouped

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FileUpload.razor -->
```razor
<GupFileItem FileName="report-2024-q1.pdf" Subtitle="01.03.2024, 1.2 MB" />
<GupFileItem FileName="report-2024-q2.pdf" Subtitle="01.06.2024, 1.4 MB" />
<GupFileItem FileName="report-2024-q3.pdf" Subtitle="01.09.2024, 1.3 MB" />
```

### File library saved files list

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FileUpload.razor -->
```razor
<GupFileUpload Name="library" Multiple="true">
    <ChildContent>Upload files</ChildContent>
    <ExtraAction>
        <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Text"
                   OnClick="@(() => Alert("Saved files clicked (File library)"))">
            <ChildContent>Saved files</ChildContent>
        </GupButton>
    </ExtraAction>
</GupFileUpload>
<div style="margin-top: var(--gup-spacing-text-to-component);">
    <GupFileItem FileName="file.png" Subtitle="09.02.2021, 2 MB" Url="/file.png">
        <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Text"
                   OnClick="@(() => Alert("You clicked on Select button"))">
            <ChildContent>Select</ChildContent>
        </GupButton>
    </GupFileItem>
    <GupFileItem FileName="file2.png" Subtitle="09.02.2021, 2 MB" Url="/file2.png">
        <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Text"
                   OnClick="@(() => Alert("You clicked on Select button"))">
            <ChildContent>Select</ChildContent>
        </GupButton>
    </GupFileItem>
</div>
```

# GupFileUpload

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupFileUpload.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/file-upload

Drag-and-drop or browse, with file list and remove actions.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-file-upload name="..." accept="..." multiple required full-width error-message="..." allow-thumbnails max-file-size="50"> Named slots: ChildContent (label), Hint, ExtraAction Uses plain JS (window.__gupFileUpload) for interactivity. When OnChange is set, JS notifies .NET via DotNetObjectReference (requires interactive render mode).
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Name` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — |  |
| `FileInputLabel` | `string` | `"Choose file"` | — |  |
| `ItemDeleteLabel` | `string` | `"Remove the file"` | — |  |
| `Accept` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — |  |
| `Multiple` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `Required` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `IsFullWidth` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `ErrorMessage` | `string?` | — | — |  |
| `IsInvalid` | `bool` | — | — | Force the invalid (red) border without an error message, e.g. when a parent form flags the field from its own validation summary. |
| `AllowThumbnails` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `SizeValidationMessage` | `string` | `"Maximum file size exceeded!"` | — |  |
| `MaxFileSize` | `int` | `50` | — |  |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |
| `<Hint>` |  |
| `<ExtraAction>` |  |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `OnChange` | `EventCallback<IReadOnlyList<GupFileUploadFile>>` |  |

> Members of `GupFileUploadFile` are documented in [support types](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SMEDAOman/GUPBlazor/main/docs/ai/types.md).

## Cascading values consumed

- CascadedReadOnly (cascading name: "GupReadOnly")

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Single file no hint

```razor
    <ChildContent>Upload a file</ChildContent>
</GupFileUpload>
```

```razor
    <ChildContent>Upload a file</ChildContent>
```
```razor
    <Hint>Select files up to 5 MB</Hint>

```

```razor
</GupFileUpload>
```

```razor
<GupFileUpload Name="with-files" AllowThumbnails="true">
    <ChildContent>Upload a file</ChildContent>
</GupFileUpload>
```

# GupFilterChip

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupFilterChip.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/filter-chip

Removable chips for active filters.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-filter-chip kind="button|link" disabled href="..." hide-close-icon> A pill-shaped chip used to display a user-selected filter. As a "button" it renders a close (×) icon and emits OnClick when activated; as a "link" it navigates to Href. Two-way binding: @bind-Kind, @bind-Disabled, @bind-Href, @bind-HideCloseIcon Events:          OnClick (fires when the button-kind chip is clicked)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Kind` | `GupFilterChipKind` | `GupFilterChipKind.Button` | `@bind-Kind` | Whether the chip behaves as a button (default — closeable) or a link. |
| `Disabled` | `bool` | — | `@bind-Disabled` | Whether the button-kind chip is disabled. Ignored when Kind=Link. |
| `Href` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | `@bind-Href` | Target URL when Kind=Link. |
| `HideCloseIcon` | `bool` | — | `@bind-HideCloseIcon` | Hides the trailing close (×) icon. Only relevant when Kind=Button. |
| `AriaLabel` | `string?` | — | — | Optional accessible label — useful when the chip's only visible content is the close icon. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Chip label content. Avoid placing interactive elements inside. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KindChanged` | `EventCallback<GupFilterChipKind>` |  |
| `DisabledChanged` | `EventCallback<bool>` |  |
| `HrefChanged` | `EventCallback<string>` |  |
| `HideCloseIconChanged` | `EventCallback<bool>` |  |
| `OnClick` | `EventCallback<MouseEventArgs>` | Fires when the button-kind chip is activated (click / Enter / Space). |

## Enums

### `GupFilterChipKind`

Whether the filter chip renders as a button (default — closeable) or a link. Mirrors gup-filter-chip's `kind` attribute.

- `GupFilterChipKind.Button`
- `GupFilterChipKind.Link`

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Default button

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FilterChip.razor -->
```razor
<GupFilterChip>I am a button</GupFilterChip>
```

### Disabled

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FilterChip.razor -->
```razor
<GupFilterChip Disabled="true">I am disabled</GupFilterChip>
```

### Link

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FilterChip.razor -->
```razor
<GupFilterChip Kind="@GupFilterChipKind.Link" Href="#">I am a link</GupFilterChip>
```

### Without close icon

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FilterChip.razor -->
```razor
<GupFilterChip HideCloseIcon="true">No close icon</GupFilterChip>
```

### Wrapper basic

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FilterChip.razor -->
```razor
<GupFilterChipWrapper ClearLabel="Clear all">
    <Label>Search in:</Label>
    <ChildContent>
        <GupFilterChip>Filter 1</GupFilterChip>
        <GupFilterChip>Filter 2</GupFilterChip>
        <GupFilterChip>Filter 3</GupFilterChip>
        <GupFilterChip>Filter 4</GupFilterChip>
    </ChildContent>
</GupFilterChipWrapper>
```

### Mixed kinds inside a wrapper

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FilterChip.razor -->
```razor
<GupFilterChipWrapper ClearLabel="Clear all">
    <Label>Mixed:</Label>
    <ChildContent>
        <GupFilterChip>Button chip</GupFilterChip>
        <GupFilterChip Kind="@GupFilterChipKind.Link" Href="#">Link chip</GupFilterChip>
        <GupFilterChip HideCloseIcon="true">No icon</GupFilterChip>
        <GupFilterChip Disabled="true">Disabled</GupFilterChip>
    </ChildContent>
</GupFilterChipWrapper>
```

### Rtl arabic

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FilterChip.razor -->
```razor
<GupFilterChipWrapper ClearLabel="مسح الكل">
    <Label>البحث في:</Label>
    <ChildContent>
        <GupFilterChip>الفرز الأول</GupFilterChip>
        <GupFilterChip>الفرز الثاني</GupFilterChip>
        <GupFilterChip>الفرز الثالث</GupFilterChip>
        <GupFilterChip>الفرز الرابع</GupFilterChip>
    </ChildContent>
</GupFilterChipWrapper>
```

# GupFilterChipWrapper

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupFilterChipWrapper.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/filter-chip

Part of the Filter chip component set — see the Filter chip page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-filter-chip-wrapper clear-label="Clear all"> Groups GupFilterChip elements with an optional leading label and a trailing "clear all" button. Renders the chips in a multi-line GupTrack. Default slot:  ChildContent — should contain only GupFilterChip elements Named slot:    Label         — group label rendered before the chips Two-way bind:  @bind-ClearLabel Events:        OnClearAll    — fires when the "clear all" button is clicked
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ClearLabel` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | `@bind-ClearLabel` | Label for the trailing "clear all" button. When empty, the button is hidden. |
| `AriaLabel` | `string?` | — | — | Optional accessible label for the wrapper region. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<Label>` | Group label rendered before the chips. |
| `<ChildContent>` | Default slot — should contain only GupFilterChip elements. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ClearLabelChanged` | `EventCallback<string>` |  |
| `OnClearAll` | `EventCallback<MouseEventArgs>` | Fires when the "clear all" button is clicked. |

## Examples

```razor
        <GupFilterChip>Filter 3</GupFilterChip>
        <GupFilterChip>Filter 4</GupFilterChip>

</GupFilterChipWrapper>
```

### Mixed kinds inside a wrapper

```razor
    <Label>Mixed:</Label>
    <ChildContent>
        <GupFilterChip>Button chip</GupFilterChip>
        <GupFilterChip Kind="@GupFilterChipKind.Link" Href="#">Link chip</GupFilterChip>

    </ChildContent>
</GupFilterChipWrapper>
```

# GupFlag

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupFlag.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/flag

Country flags in rectangle and circle shapes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-flag country-name="om" shape="rectangle|circle" size="20"> Renders a country flag from the SVG set bundled under wwwroot/flags. CountryName accepts either an English country name ("Oman") or an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code ("om"), matched case-insensitively. An unknown value renders an empty placeholder of the same size. The browser fetches each SVG on demand and caches it, so a page only downloads the flags it actually shows.
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CountryName` | `string?` | — | — | English country name (e.g. `Oman`) or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. `om`). Matching ignores case. An unrecognised value renders an empty placeholder of the same size rather than throwing. |
| `Shape` | `GupFlagShape` | `GupFlagShape.Rectangle` | — | Shape of the flag: 4:3 rectangle (default) or 1:1 circle. |
| `Size` | `int` | `20` | — | Height of the flag in pixels; the width follows from `Shape`. Default: 20. |
| `Alt` | `string?` | — | — | Alternative text for the image. Defaults to the resolved country name. Set to an empty string when the flag is decorative and the country is already named in adjacent text. |
| `BasePath` | `string` | `"_content/GUPBlazor/flags"` | — | Base path the bundled flag SVGs are served from. A shape subfolder (`4x3` or `1x1`) and `<code>.svg` are appended, so an override must point at a directory containing those subfolders. |

## Enums

### `GupFlagShape`

Aspect ratio and corner treatment of a `GupFlag`.

- `GupFlagShape.Rectangle` — 4:3 rectangle flag (default).
- `GupFlagShape.Circle` — 1:1 circle flag.

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Default rectangle

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Flag.razor -->
```razor
<GupTrack Direction="horizontal" Gap="3">
    <GupFlag CountryName="om" />
    <GupFlag CountryName="ae" />
    <GupFlag CountryName="sa" />
    <GupFlag CountryName="kw" />
    <GupFlag CountryName="qa" />
    <GupFlag CountryName="bh" />
</GupTrack>
```

### Circle shape

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Flag.razor -->
```razor
<GupTrack Direction="horizontal" Gap="3">
    <GupFlag CountryName="om" Shape="@GupFlagShape.Circle" Size="32" />
    <GupFlag CountryName="ch" Shape="@GupFlagShape.Circle" Size="32" />
    <GupFlag CountryName="jp" Shape="@GupFlagShape.Circle" Size="32" />
    <GupFlag CountryName="br" Shape="@GupFlagShape.Circle" Size="32" />
    <GupFlag CountryName="in" Shape="@GupFlagShape.Circle" Size="32" />
</GupTrack>
```

### Unknown country

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Flag.razor -->
```razor
<GupTrack Direction="horizontal" Gap="3">
    <GupFlag CountryName="om" Size="32" />
    <GupFlag CountryName="zz" Size="32" />
    <GupFlag CountryName="Atlantis" Size="32" />
</GupTrack>
```

### Code or country name

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Flag.razor -->
```razor
<GupTrack Direction="horizontal" Gap="4">
    <span><GupFlag CountryName="om" /> <code>"om"</code></span>
    <span><GupFlag CountryName="Oman" /> <code>"Oman"</code></span>
    <span><GupFlag CountryName="CH" /> <code>"CH"</code></span>
    <span><GupFlag CountryName="Switzerland" /> <code>"Switzerland"</code></span>
</GupTrack>
```

### Size

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Flag.razor -->
```razor
<GupTrack Direction="horizontal" Gap="3" VerticalAlignment="center">
    <GupFlag CountryName="om" Size="16" />
    <GupFlag CountryName="om" Size="24" />
    <GupFlag CountryName="om" Size="40" />
    <GupFlag CountryName="om" Size="64" />
    <GupFlag CountryName="om" Size="96" />
</GupTrack>
```

# GupFlyout

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupFlyout.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/flyout

Side panel from any edge — the mobile-friendly home for add-row forms.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-flyout heading="..." position="right|left|top|bottom" backdrop hide-close-button> A side / top / bottom panel that slides into view from an edge of the viewport. Slots: ChildContent  — main body content FooterContent — optional footer (typically action buttons) Two-way binding: @bind-IsOpen   — controls visibility (Show/Hide are equivalent) @bind-Position — current edge the panel slides from Events: OnOpen   — fires when the flyout becomes visible OnClose  — fires when the flyout closes (close button, backdrop, or ESC)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Dir` | `string?` | — | — | Explicit text direction ('rtl' or 'ltr'). If omitted, auto-detects from IsRTL or active page context. |
| `IsRTL` | `bool?` | — | — | Whether the flyout is rendered in Right-To-Left direction. |
| `Heading` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — | Heading text shown in the flyout header. |
| `Position` | `GupFlyoutPosition` | `GupFlyoutPosition.Right` | `@bind-Position` | Edge the flyout slides from. Default: Right. |
| `IsOpen` | `bool` | — | `@bind-IsOpen` | Whether the flyout is open. Supports two-way binding via @@bind-IsOpen. |
| `HideCloseButton` | `bool` | — | — | Hide the built-in close button. ESC and backdrop click still close the flyout unless disabled separately. |
| `CloseLabel` | `string` | `"Close"` | — | Accessible label for the close button. Default: "Close". |
| `Backdrop` | `bool` | `true` | — | Show the dimmed backdrop behind the flyout panel. Default: true. |
| `CloseOnBackdropClick` | `bool` | `true` | — | Whether clicking on the backdrop should close the flyout. Default: true. |
| `CloseOnEscape` | `bool` | `true` | — | Whether pressing ESC should close the flyout. Default: true. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Main body content of the flyout. |
| `<FooterContent>` | Optional footer content (typically action buttons). |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PositionChanged` | `EventCallback<GupFlyoutPosition>` |  |
| `IsOpenChanged` | `EventCallback<bool>` |  |
| `OnOpen` | `EventCallback` | Fires when the flyout becomes visible. |
| `OnClose` | `EventCallback` | Fires when the flyout closes (close button, backdrop click, or ESC). |

## Enums

### `GupFlyoutPosition`

- `GupFlyoutPosition.Right`
- `GupFlyoutPosition.Left`
- `GupFlyoutPosition.Top`
- `GupFlyoutPosition.Bottom`

## Cascading values consumed

- WizardStack
- CascadedLangId (cascading name: "GupLangId")

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### From the Flyout page template

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Flyout.razor -->
```razor
<GupFlyout Heading="Right flyout"
           @bind-IsOpen="_rightOpen"
           Position="@GupFlyoutPosition.Right"
           OnOpen="@(() => LogEvent("right-open"))"
           OnClose="@(() => LogEvent("right-close"))">
  <ChildContent>
    <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:24px;">
      <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px;">
        <span style="font-size:16px; font-weight:700; line-height:24px;">Civil ID</span>
        <span style="font-size:20px; font-weight:400; line-height:28px;">1034580392</span>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px;">
        <span style="font-size:16px; font-weight:700; line-height:24px;">Expiry Date</span>
        <span style="font-size:20px; font-weight:400; line-height:28px;">01/02/2028</span>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px;">
        <span style="font-size:16px; font-weight:700; line-height:24px;">Full Name</span>
        <span style="font-size:20px; font-weight:400; line-height:28px;">First Name Last Name</span>
      </div>
      <GupTrack Direction="vertical" Gap="2">
        <GupInputField Type="text" Placeholder="Update field">Name</GupInputField>
        <GupInputField Type="email" Placeholder="Update field">Email</GupInputField>
      </GupTrack>
    </div>
  </ChildContent>
  <FooterContent>
    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap:12px; width:100%;">
      <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary"
                 OnClick="@(() => CloseFlyout("right-cancel"))">
        <ChildContent>Cancel</ChildContent>
      </GupButton>
      <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary"
                 OnClick="@(() => CloseFlyout("right-save"))">
        <ChildContent>Save changes</ChildContent>
      </GupButton>
    </div>
  </FooterContent>
</GupFlyout>
```

### From the Flyout page template

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Flyout.razor -->
```razor
<GupFlyout Heading="Filters"
           @bind-IsOpen="_leftOpen"
           Position="@GupFlyoutPosition.Left"
           OnOpen="@(() => LogEvent("left-open"))"
           OnClose="@(() => LogEvent("left-close"))">
  <ChildContent>
    <GupTrack Direction="vertical" Gap="2">
      <GupInputField Type="text" Placeholder="Filter A">Filter A</GupInputField>
      <GupInputField Type="text" Placeholder="Filter B">Filter B</GupInputField>
      <GupInputField Type="text" Placeholder="Filter C">Filter C</GupInputField>
    </GupTrack>
  </ChildContent>
  <FooterContent>
    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; width:100%;">
      <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Text" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
                 OnClick="@(() => LogEvent("left-clear-all"))">
        <ChildContent>Clear all</ChildContent>
      </GupButton>
      <GupButtonGroup>
        <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary"
                   OnClick="@(() => CloseFlyout("left-cancel"))">
          <ChildContent>Cancel</ChildContent>
        </GupButton>
        <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary"
                   OnClick="@(() => CloseFlyout("left-apply"))">
          <ChildContent>Apply</ChildContent>
        </GupButton>
      </GupButtonGroup>
    </div>
  </FooterContent>
</GupFlyout>
```

# GupFormList

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupFormList.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/form-list

Part of the Form list component set — see the Form list page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-form-list> — vertical flex container for form fields
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

```razor
    <GupInputField Name="ro-email" Type="email" @bind-Value="_email">Email address</GupInputField>
    @* Affix buttons: the picker and the show/hide toggle must disable too. *@
    <GupInputField Name="ro-date" Type="date" @bind-Value="_date">Date of birth</GupInputField>
    <GupInputField Name="ro-password" Type="password" @bind-Value="_password">Password</GupInputField>
    @* Required + empty: must not show a validation error while locked. *@
    <GupInputField Name="ro-required" Type="text" @bind-Value="_required" Required="true">Required, left empty</GupInputField>
    @* Already opted out locally; the cascade must not un-disable it. *@
    <GupInputField Name="ro-own-disabled" Type="text" Disabled="true">Disabled on its own</GupInputField>
</GupFormList>
```

# GupFormSection

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupFormSection.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/form-section

Titled section with optional footer for action buttons.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-form-section> A section in a long form with a heading and an optional footer (typically a GupButtonGroup with action buttons). Slots: - Title          → rich content for the section heading (overrides Heading) - ChildContent   → main content of the section (default slot) - FooterContent  → optional footer with action buttons (use GupButtonGroup) Two-way binding: @bind-Heading Events: OnFooterClick (fires when the footer area is clicked, useful for bubbling up button clicks without wiring each one individually)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Heading` | `string?` | — | `@bind-Heading` | Plain-text section heading. Use `Title` for rich content. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<Title>` | Rich content for the section heading. Overrides `Heading`. |
| `<ChildContent>` | Main content of the section. |
| `<FooterContent>` | Optional footer — typically a GupButtonGroup with action buttons. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `HeadingChanged` | `EventCallback<string?>` |  |
| `OnFooterClick` | `EventCallback<MouseEventArgs>` | Fires when the footer area is clicked. |

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Default title content

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FormSection.razor -->
```razor
<GupFormSection>
    <Title>Personal information</Title>
    <ChildContent>
        <GupFormList>
            <GupInputField Name="default-first-name" Type="text">First name</GupInputField>
            <GupInputField Name="default-last-name" Type="text">Last name</GupInputField>
            <GupInputField Name="default-national-id" Type="text">National ID</GupInputField>
        </GupFormList>
    </ChildContent>
</GupFormSection>
```

### With footer action buttons

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FormSection.razor -->
```razor
<GupFormSection>
    <Title>Contact details</Title>
    <ChildContent>
        <GupFormList>
            <GupInputField Name="footer-email" Type="email">Email</GupInputField>
            <GupInputField Name="footer-phone" Type="tel">Mobile number</GupInputField>
        </GupFormList>
    </ChildContent>
    <FooterContent>
        <GupButtonGroup>
            <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary"
                       Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
                       OnClick="HandleSave">
                <ChildContent>Save</ChildContent>
            </GupButton>
            <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary"
                       Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
                       OnClick="HandleCancel">
                <ChildContent>Cancel</ChildContent>
            </GupButton>
        </GupButtonGroup>
    </FooterContent>
</GupFormSection>

<p data-testid="footer-log" style="margin: 8px 0 0;">
    Last footer action: <strong>@_lastFooterAction</strong>
</p>
```

### Multiple form sections

```razor

    <Title>Section 1 — Applicant</Title>
    <ChildContent>
        <GupFormList>
            <GupInputField Name="multi-name" Type="text">Full name</GupInputField>
            <GupInputField Name="multi-civil-id" Type="text">Civil ID</GupInputField>
        </GupFormList>
    </ChildContent>
</GupFormSection>

    <Title>Section 2 — Address</Title>
    <ChildContent>
        <GupFormList>
            <GupInputField Name="multi-street" Type="text">Street</GupInputField>
            <GupInputField Name="multi-city" Type="text">City</GupInputField>
            <GupInputField Name="multi-postcode" Type="text">Postcode</GupInputField>
        </GupFormList>
    </ChildContent>

            <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary"
                       Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button">

        </GupButtonGroup>
    </FooterContent>
</GupFormSection>
```

```razor
        </p>
    </ChildContent>
</GupFormSection>
```

### Rich title content

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FormSection.razor -->

```razor
    <Title>
        <span style="display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;">
            Identity verification
```

### Rtl arabic

```razor
    <Title>المعلومات الشخصية</Title>

            <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary"
                       Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button">
                <ChildContent>إلغاء</ChildContent>
            </GupButton>
        </GupButtonGroup>
    </FooterContent>
</GupFormSection>
```

### Two way binding bind heading

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FormSection.razor -->
```razor
<div data-testid="bound-section">
    <GupFormSection @bind-Heading="_boundHeading">
        <ChildContent>
            <p style="margin: 0; color: var(--gup-color-content-primary);">
                The heading is bound to a parent variable. Edit it below and the title updates live.
            </p>
        </ChildContent>
    </GupFormSection>
</div>

<label style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; max-width:480px;">
    <span style="font-weight: var(--font-weight-base-beta);">Heading</span>
    <input data-testid="heading-input"
           type="text"
           value="@_boundHeading"
           @oninput="OnHeadingInput"
           style="padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid var(--gup-color-border-medium); border-radius:4px; font-size:16px;" />
</label>

<p data-testid="bind-output" style="margin:0;">
    Bound heading: <strong>@_boundHeading</strong>
</p>
```

### Onfooterclick event

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../FormSection.razor -->
```razor
<div data-testid="footer-click-section">
<GupFormSection OnFooterClick="HandleFooterAreaClick">
    <Title>Footer click delegation</Title>
    <ChildContent>
        <p style="margin: 0; color: var(--gup-color-content-primary);">
            Click any of the buttons below — the parent component logs the click.
        </p>
    </ChildContent>
    <FooterContent>
        <GupButtonGroup>
            <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary"
                       Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button">
                <ChildContent>Action 1</ChildContent>
            </GupButton>
            <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary"
                       Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button">
                <ChildContent>Action 2</ChildContent>
            </GupButton>
            <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Text"
                       Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button">
                <ChildContent>Action 3</ChildContent>
            </GupButton>
        </GupButtonGroup>
    </FooterContent>
</GupFormSection>
</div>

<p data-testid="footer-click-log" style="margin:0;">
    Footer area clicks: <strong>@_footerClickCount</strong>
</p>
```

# GupIcon

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.

```text
Renders a Material Symbols Outlined icon via the Google variable font.
```

```razor

```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |

| `Grade` | `int` | `0` | — |  |
| `RtlFlipEnabled` | `bool` | — | — | Flip the icon horizontally in RTL layouts (matches `rtl-flip-enabled`). |
| `FillColor` | `string?` | — | — | Fill color in any CSS format (matches `fill-color` / `--gup-icon--fill-color`). |

# GupImage

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupImage.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/image

Responsive image with aspect-ratio and object-fit control.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-image src="..." alt="..." width="..." height="..." loading="lazy|eager" error-message="..."> A component for displaying images with branded captions and graceful error fallback. Slots / RenderFragments: - CaptionContent â†’ optional caption rendered in a <figcaption> beneath the image - ErrorContent   â†’ optional custom error UI (replaces the default error message when the image fails to load) Two-way binding: @bind-Src, @bind-Alt, @bind-ErrorMessage, @bind-Loading, @bind-Width, @bind-Height Events: OnError, OnLoad
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Src` | `string` | `string.Empty` | `@bind-Src` | The source URL of the image. |
| `Alt` | `string` | `string.Empty` | `@bind-Alt` | The alt text for the image. |
| `ErrorMessage` | `string` | `"Error loading image"` | `@bind-ErrorMessage` | The error message shown when the image fails to load. Overridden by `ErrorContent`. |
| `Loading` | `GupImageLoading?` | — | `@bind-Loading` | Image loading strategy â€” lazy or eager. When null, the attribute is omitted. |
| `Width` | `int?` | — | `@bind-Width` | The intrinsic width of the image (in pixels). |
| `Height` | `int?` | — | `@bind-Height` | The intrinsic height of the image (in pixels). |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<CaptionContent>` | Optional caption rendered in a `<figcaption>` below the image. |
| `<ErrorContent>` | Optional custom error UI â€” when provided, replaces the default error message. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SrcChanged` | `EventCallback<string>` |  |
| `AltChanged` | `EventCallback<string>` |  |
| `ErrorMessageChanged` | `EventCallback<string>` |  |
| `LoadingChanged` | `EventCallback<GupImageLoading?>` |  |
| `WidthChanged` | `EventCallback<int?>` |  |
| `HeightChanged` | `EventCallback<int?>` |  |
| `OnError` | `EventCallback` | Fires when the underlying `<img>` emits an error event (image failed to load). |
| `OnLoad` | `EventCallback` | Fires when the underlying `<img>` finishes loading successfully. |

## Enums

### `GupImageLoading`

Image loading strategy passed to the underlying <img> element. Browsers that don't support the attribute will silently ignore it.

- `GupImageLoading.Lazy` — Defer loading until the image enters the viewport.
- `GupImageLoading.Eager` — Load the image immediately (default browser behaviour).

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Default

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Image.razor -->
```razor
<GupImage Src="@_unsplashSrc"
          Alt="A scenic landscape"
          Width="300"
          Height="300" />
```

### With caption

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Image.razor -->
```razor
<GupImage Src="@_unsplashSrc"
          Alt="A scenic landscape"
          Width="300"
          Height="300">
    <CaptionContent>Caption</CaptionContent>
</GupImage>
```

### Caption with custom html

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Image.razor -->
```razor
<GupImage Src="@_unsplashSrc"
          Alt="A scenic landscape"
          Width="300"
          Height="300">
    <CaptionContent>
        Caption with some HTML, eg. an <strong>accent</strong>
    </CaptionContent>
</GupImage>
```

### Error message default fallback

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Image.razor -->

```razor
<GupImage Src="invalid-url"
          Alt="Won't load"

          Height="300"
          ErrorMessage="Error loading image" />
```

```razor
          Height="300">

        <div style="width:300px; height:300px; border:1px solid #e2e2e2;
                    border-radius:12px; display:flex; justify-content:center;
                    align-items:center; background:#f8f8f8;">
            Image failed to load 🤕
        </div>
    </ErrorContent>
</GupImage>
```

### Lazy loading

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Image.razor -->
```razor
<GupImage Src="@_unsplashSrc"
          Alt="Lazy-loaded landscape"
          Width="300"
          Height="300"
          Loading="GupImageLoading.Lazy">
    <CaptionContent>This image uses <code>loading="lazy"</code>.</CaptionContent>
</GupImage>
```

### Two way binding bind src bind alt bind width bind height bind loading

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Image.razor -->
```razor
<GupImage @bind-Src="_boundSrc"
          @bind-Alt="_boundAlt"
          @bind-Width="_boundWidth"
          @bind-Height="_boundHeight"
          @bind-Loading="_boundLoading">
    <CaptionContent>Bound image — change the controls below.</CaptionContent>
</GupImage>

<div style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center;">
    <strong>Source:</strong>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => { _boundSrc = _unsplashSrc; _boundAlt = "A scenic landscape"; })">
        <ChildContent>Landscape</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => { _boundSrc = _picsumSrc; _boundAlt = "Random Picsum photo"; })">
        <ChildContent>Picsum</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => { _boundSrc = "invalid"; _boundAlt = "Broken"; })">
        <ChildContent>Broken</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
</div>

<div style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center;">
    <strong>Size:</strong>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => { _boundWidth = 200; _boundHeight = 200; })">
        <ChildContent>200 × 200</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => { _boundWidth = 300; _boundHeight = 300; })">
        <ChildContent>300 × 300</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => { _boundWidth = 400; _boundHeight = 250; })">
        <ChildContent>400 × 250</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
</div>

<div style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center;">
    <strong>Loading:</strong>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundLoading = null)">
        <ChildContent>(none)</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundLoading = GupImageLoading.Lazy)">
        <ChildContent>Lazy</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundLoading = GupImageLoading.Eager)">
        <ChildContent>Eager</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
</div>

<p data-testid="bind-output" style="margin:0;">
    Bound state: src = <strong>@(_boundSrc.Length > 40 ? _boundSrc.Substring(0, 40) + "…" : _boundSrc)</strong>,
    alt = <strong>@_boundAlt</strong>,
    size = <strong>@_boundWidth × @_boundHeight</strong>,
    loading = <strong>@(_boundLoading?.ToString() ?? "(none)")</strong>
</p>
```

### Onload and onerror events

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Image.razor -->
```razor
<GupImage Src="@_eventSrc"
          Alt="Event demo image"
          Width="200"
          Height="200"
          OnLoad="HandleImageLoad"
          OnError="HandleImageError" />

<div style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center;">
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _eventSrc = _picsumSrc + "?v=" + DateTime.UtcNow.Ticks)">
        <ChildContent>Load valid image</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _eventSrc = "broken-" + DateTime.UtcNow.Ticks)">
        <ChildContent>Load broken image</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
</div>

<p data-testid="event-log" style="margin:0;">
    Loads: <strong>@_loadCount</strong> · Errors: <strong>@_errorCount</strong>
</p>
```

# GupInputField

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupInputField.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/inputs/text

Single-line text with label, hint, error and read-only states.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-input-field name="..." type="text|email|date|time|password|number|numeric|tel|url">Label</gup-input-field> Two-way binding: @bind-Value Slots (RenderFragment): ChildContent (label), Prefix, Suffix, InputStart, InputEnd, Hint, ErrorMessageContent, Popup Events: OnValueChange (input), OnChange (commit/blur), OnKeyDown, OnFocus, OnInvalid Validation: self-validates against Pattern, MinLength, MaxLength, Required after the user interacts. Parent can force the error state via IsInvalid.
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Name` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — |  |
| `Type` | `string` | `"text"` | — |  |
| `Placeholder` | `string?` | — | — |  |
| `Value` | `string?` | — | `@bind-Value` |  |
| `Disabled` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `Readonly` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `Required` | `bool` | `true` | — |  |
| `MinLength` | `int?` | — | — |  |
| `MaxLength` | `int?` | — | — |  |
| `Min` | `string?` | — | — |  |
| `Max` | `string?` | — | — |  |
| `Pattern` | `string?` | — | — |  |
| `Step` | `int?` | — | — |  |
| `LabelHidden` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `ErrorMessage` | `string?` | — | — |  |
| `IsInvalid` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `StrictNumeric` | `bool` | — | — | When true and Type is "numeric" or "tel", non-digit keystrokes are stripped on input. Deviates from the design-system spec (which only validates, not filters) — opt in deliberately. |
| `InputRole` | `string?` | — | — |  |
| `AriaControlsId` | `string?` | — | — |  |
| `AriaExpandedState` | `bool?` | — | — |  |
| `AriaHasPopupType` | `string?` | — | — |  |
| `AriaActiveDescendantId` | `string?` | — | — |  |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |
| `<Prefix>` |  |
| `<Suffix>` |  |
| `<InputStart>` |  |
| `<InputEnd>` |  |
| `<Hint>` |  |
| `<ErrorMessageContent>` |  |
| `<Popup>` |  |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ValueChanged` | `EventCallback<string?>` |  |
| `OnValueChange` | `EventCallback<string?>` | Fires whenever the input value changes (on every keystroke). |
| `OnChange` | `EventCallback<string?>` | Fires when the input value is committed (change event / blur). |
| `OnKeyDown` | `EventCallback<KeyboardEventArgs>` | Fires when a key is pressed inside the input. |
| `OnFocus` | `EventCallback<FocusEventArgs>` | Fires when the input is focused. |
| `OnInvalid` | `EventCallback` | Fires when the native input becomes invalid. |

## Cascading values consumed

- CascadedLangId (cascading name: "GupLangId")
- CascadedReadOnly (cascading name: "GupReadOnly")

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Hint

```razor
  <ChildContent>Civil ID</ChildContent>

</GupInputField>
```

```razor
               ErrorMessage="Enter an email address in the format name@example.com">
  Email address
</GupInputField>
```

```razor
               ErrorMessage="Enter your Civil ID">
  <ChildContent>Civil ID</ChildContent>
  <Hint>Eight digits, printed on the front of your card.</Hint>
</GupInputField>
```

```razor
  <ChildContent>Commercial registration number</ChildContent>
  <ErrorMessageContent>

  </ErrorMessageContent>
```

### Two way binding bind text

```razor
               @bind-Value="_boundText"

    <GupScreenReaderText @bind-Text="_boundText" OnRendered="HandleRendered" />
</p>

    <strong>Bound text:</strong> "<span data-testid="bind-value">@_boundText</span>"
    &nbsp;·&nbsp;
```

### Input field gupinputfield

```razor
    <GupInputField Name="demo-text" Type="text">Full name</GupInputField>
    <GupInputField Name="demo-email" Type="email">Email address</GupInputField>
    <GupInputField Name="demo-tel" Type="tel">Phone number</GupInputField>
    <GupInputField Name="demo-date" Type="date">Date of birth</GupInputField>
    <GupInputField Name="demo-password" Type="password">Password</GupInputField>
    <GupInputField Name="demo-readonly" Type="text" Value="Read-only value" Readonly="true">Read-only field</GupInputField>
```

# GupLabelledItem

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupLabelledItem.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/labelled-item

Part of the Labelled item component set — see the Labelled item page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-labelled-item> A generic component to label any static content. Produces a form-item-like layout with a label above the content. Used inside GupDataSheet but also on its own to display read-only data. Parameters / slots: - Label         (string, two-way bindable) → simple text label - LabelContent  (RenderFragment)           → richer label content (overrides Label) - IconContent   (RenderFragment)           → optional icon next to the content (use a GupIcon) - ChildContent  (RenderFragment)           → the content being labelled (default slot) Events: OnClick — fires when the labelled item is activated.
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Label` | `string?` | — | `@bind-Label` | Plain-text label. Use `LabelContent` for richer content. |
| `AriaLabel` | `string?` | — | — | Accessible label for the item — used when the item is clickable. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<LabelContent>` | Rich label content — takes precedence over `Label` when set. |
| `<IconContent>` | Optional icon rendered next to the value (insert a GupIcon). |
| `<ChildContent>` | The labelled value / content (default slot). |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `LabelChanged` | `EventCallback<string?>` |  |
| `OnClick` | `EventCallback<MouseEventArgs>` | Fires when the item is clicked or activated by keyboard (Enter/Space). |

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Basic

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../LabelledItem.razor -->


### With labelled items

```razor
        </GupLabelledItem>

                <GupIcon IconName="receipt" Width="30" Height="30" />
            </IconContent>

        </GupLabelledItem>
    </ChildContent>
</GupDataSheet>
```

### Rich label content

```razor
                </span>
            </LabelContent>

        </GupLabelledItem>

                <span style="display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
                    <GupIcon IconName="event" Width="16" Height="16" /> Submitted on
```

### Click events

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../DataSheet.razor -->

```razor
              OnClick="HandleSheetClick">

        <GupLabelledItem Label="Service"
                         AriaLabel="Edit service"

            <ChildContent>Click me — labelled item</ChildContent>
        </GupLabelledItem>

            <ChildContent>Click outside any item — bubbles to the sheet</ChildContent>

    Sheet clicks: <strong data-testid="sheet-clicks">@_sheetClicks</strong> ·

</p>
```

### Two way binding bind label

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../DataSheet.razor -->
```razor
<input data-testid="bind-input"
       type="text"
       value="@_boundLabel"
       @oninput="OnBoundLabelInput"
       style="padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid var(--gup-color-border-low); border-radius:8px;" />

<GupDataSheet>
    <ChildContent>
        <GupLabelledItem @bind-Label="_boundLabel">
            <ChildContent>Bound value renders here.</ChildContent>
        </GupLabelledItem>
    </ChildContent>
</GupDataSheet>

<p data-testid="bind-output" style="margin:0;">
    Bound label: <strong>@_boundLabel</strong>
</p>
```

# GupLink

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupLink.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/buttons

Part of the Button component set — see the Button page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-link kind="link|button" size="s|m|l" severity="primary|secondary|danger" href="..." disabled open-in-new-tab> Default slot: ChildContent (the link label) Events: OnClick (fires when a kind="button" link is clicked — matches gup-click)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Kind` | `string` | `"link"` | — | Whether the link renders as an anchor (default) or an HTML button. |
| `Size` | `string` | `"m"` | — | Size of the link: `s`, `m` (default), or `l`. |
| `Severity` | `string` | `"primary"` | — | Visual severity: `primary` (default), `secondary`, or `danger`. |
| `Href` | `string` | `"#"` | — | Target URL. Only relevant when `Kind` is `link`. |
| `Target` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — | Explicit anchor target. Overrides `OpenInNewTab` if set. |
| `OpenInNewTab` | `bool` | — | — | Open the URL in a new tab. Only applicable when `Kind` is `link`. |
| `Disabled` | `bool` | — | — | Disable the link. Only relevant when `Kind` is `button`. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `OnClick` | `EventCallback<MouseEventArgs>` | Fires when a `kind="button"` link is clicked (matches the `gup-click` event). |

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Link variants

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../DataDisplay.razor -->
```razor
<GupTrack Direction="vertical" Gap="4">
  <div><GupLink Href="#">Default link</GupLink></div>
  <div><GupLink Href="#">Visit the Gov.om portal for a full list of available e-services</GupLink></div>
  <div style="font-size: 14px;"><GupLink Href="#">Smaller context link</GupLink></div>
</GupTrack>
```

### Rich text with lists

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../DataDisplay.razor -->
```razor
<GupRichText>
  <p>These services are available to Omani nationals and residents:</p>
  <ol>
    <li>Visa and residency permits</li>
    <li>Business licensing</li>
    <li>Civil registration</li>
  </ol>
  <p>For more information visit <GupLink Href="https://gov.om/">gov.om</GupLink>.</p>
</GupRichText>
```

### With action slot childcontent

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Tooltip.razor -->
```razor
<GupTooltip Title="Did you know?"
            Hint="You can put any content here.">
    <Trigger>
        <GupButton Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button">
            <ChildContent>Click for details</ChildContent>
        </GupButton>
    </Trigger>
    <ChildContent>
        <GupLink Href="https://www.gov.om" Target="_blank">Learn more →</GupLink>
    </ChildContent>
</GupTooltip>
```

# GupLogo

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupLogo.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/logo

GupLogo in icon and horizontal lockups, with inversion for dark surfaces.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Gov.om logo — inline SVG from design-system source. Equivalent of <gup-logo appearance="icon|horizontal|vertical" inverted="disabled|enabled|custom" title="..." href="..." size="24">
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Appearance` | `string` | `"icon"` | — | Logo lockup: `icon` (default), `horizontal`, or `vertical`. |
| `Title` | `string` | `"Logo"` | — | Accessible description of the logo, also shown as a tooltip on hover. |
| `Inverted` | `string` | `"disabled"` | — | Invert the logo colors for dark backgrounds: `disabled` (default), `enabled`, or `custom`. |
| `Href` | `string?` | — | — | Optional link for the logo. When set, the logo is wrapped in an anchor. |
| `Size` | `int` | `24` | — | Height of the logo in px; width scales proportionally. Default: 24. |

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Icon (default)

```razor

```

### Horizontal lockup




