# GupPageStatus

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupPageStatus.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/page-status

Empty, error and loading states for a whole page.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-page-status type="success|error|expired"> A page-status block with a circular icon, title, message, and an optional action area (typically a GupButton or GupButtonGroup). Slots / RenderFragments: - TitleContent   → rich content for the heading (overrides PageTitle) - ChildContent   → message body (default slot) - ActionContent  → optional action(s) — usually a GupButton / GupButtonGroup Two-way binding: @bind-Type, @bind-PageTitle Events: OnActionClick (bubbles clicks from the action area without wiring every button individually)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Type` | `GupPageStatusType` | `GupPageStatusType.Success` | `@bind-Type` | Visual state — Success (green), Error (red), or Expired (neutral). |
| `PageTitle` | `string?` | — | `@bind-PageTitle` | Plain-text title. Use `TitleContent` for rich content. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<TitleContent>` | Rich content for the title — overrides `PageTitle`. |
| `<ChildContent>` | Message body rendered beneath the title. |
| `<ActionContent>` | Optional action area — typically a GupButton or GupButtonGroup. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TypeChanged` | `EventCallback<GupPageStatusType>` |  |
| `PageTitleChanged` | `EventCallback<string?>` |  |
| `OnActionClick` | `EventCallback<MouseEventArgs>` | Fires when the action area is clicked (event bubbles up from buttons inside). |

## Enums

### `GupPageStatusType`

Visual state of a `GupPageStatus`. Mirrors the `type` attribute on `<gup-page-status>`.

- `GupPageStatusType.Success` — Positive outcome — green background, "done" icon.
- `GupPageStatusType.Error` — Negative outcome — red background, "close" icon.
- `GupPageStatusType.Expired` — Time-bounded outcome — neutral background, "priority-high" icon.

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Success

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../PageStatus.razor -->
```razor
<GupPageStatus Type="GupPageStatusType.Success"
               PageTitle="Your payment has been processed successfully.">
    <ChildContent>Payment ID: 22399</ChildContent>
    <ActionContent>
        <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button">
            <ChildContent>Review your application</ChildContent>
        </GupButton>
    </ActionContent>
</GupPageStatus>
```

### Error

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../PageStatus.razor -->
```razor
<GupPageStatus Type="GupPageStatusType.Error"
               PageTitle="Your payment has failed.">
    <ChildContent>
        We tried to charge your card, but something went wrong. Please update your
        payment method below to continue.
    </ChildContent>
    <ActionContent>
        <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button">
            <ChildContent>Update payment method</ChildContent>
        </GupButton>
    </ActionContent>
</GupPageStatus>
```

### Expired

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../PageStatus.razor -->
```razor
<GupPageStatus Type="GupPageStatusType.Expired"
               PageTitle="Your application has expired.">
    <ChildContent>
        Unfortunately, the payment period has ended. You will need to start a new
        application. Please exit and submit a new application to proceed.
    </ChildContent>
    <ActionContent>
        <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button">
            <ChildContent>Go to dashboard</ChildContent>
        </GupButton>
    </ActionContent>
</GupPageStatus>
```

### Without an action

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../PageStatus.razor -->
```razor
<GupPageStatus Type="GupPageStatusType.Success"
               PageTitle="All done.">
    <ChildContent>Your changes have been saved.</ChildContent>
</GupPageStatus>
```

### Rich title titlecontent

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../PageStatus.razor -->
```razor
<GupPageStatus Type="GupPageStatusType.Success">
    <TitleContent>
        Welcome back, <em>Caesar</em>!
    </TitleContent>
    <ChildContent>You're signed in.</ChildContent>
</GupPageStatus>
```

### Two way binding bind type bind pagetitle

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../PageStatus.razor -->
```razor
<GupPageStatus @bind-Type="_boundType" @bind-PageTitle="_boundTitle">
    <ChildContent>Bound state — change the controls below.</ChildContent>
</GupPageStatus>

<div style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; justify-content:center;">
    <strong>Type:</strong>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => { _boundType = GupPageStatusType.Success; _boundTitle = "Looks good!"; })">
        <ChildContent>Success</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => { _boundType = GupPageStatusType.Error; _boundTitle = "Something broke."; })">
        <ChildContent>Error</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => { _boundType = GupPageStatusType.Expired; _boundTitle = "Time's up."; })">
        <ChildContent>Expired</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
</div>

<p data-testid="bind-output" style="margin:0; text-align:center;">
    Bound state: type = <strong>@_boundType</strong>,
    title = <strong>@_boundTitle</strong>
</p>
```

### Onactionclick event

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../PageStatus.razor -->
```razor
<GupPageStatus Type="GupPageStatusType.Success"
               PageTitle="All set."
               OnActionClick="HandleActionClick">
    <ChildContent>Click any of the action buttons below.</ChildContent>
    <ActionContent>
        <GupButtonGroup>
            <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button">
                <ChildContent>Continue</ChildContent>
            </GupButton>
            <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button">
                <ChildContent>View receipt</ChildContent>
            </GupButton>
        </GupButtonGroup>
    </ActionContent>
</GupPageStatus>

<p data-testid="event-log" style="margin:0; text-align:center;">
    Action clicks: <strong>@_actionClickCount</strong>
</p>
```

# GupPagination

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupPagination.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/pagination

Page controls with previous/next and page-number buttons.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-pagination kind="numbered|directional" total-pages="..." current-page="..."> Page navigation control with two layouts: - Numbered    → page-number buttons with prev/next text buttons - Directional → two large prev/next links (used as a chrome-less prev/next pair) Two-way binding: @bind-CurrentPage, @bind-Kind, @bind-TotalPages Events: OnPageChange (fires with the new page number — both before and after binding update)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TotalPages` | `int` | `10` | `@bind-TotalPages` | Total number of pages. |
| `CurrentPage` | `int` | `1` | `@bind-CurrentPage` | Currently active page (1-based). |
| `Kind` | `GupPaginationKind` | `GupPaginationKind.Numbered` | `@bind-Kind` | Layout variant — Numbered (default) or Directional. |
| `PrevLabel` | `string` | `"Previous"` | — | Label for the "Previous" button/link. |
| `PrevTitle` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — | Title shown beneath the "Previous" label (Directional kind). |
| `PrevLink` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — | Href for the "Previous" link (Directional kind). |
| `NextLabel` | `string` | `"Next"` | — | Label for the "Next" button/link. |
| `NextTitle` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — | Title shown beneath the "Next" label (Directional kind). |
| `NextLink` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — | Href for the "Next" link (Directional kind). |
| `AriaLabel` | `string` | `"Pagination"` | — | Accessible label for the surrounding <nav> element. |

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TotalPagesChanged` | `EventCallback<int>` |  |
| `CurrentPageChanged` | `EventCallback<int>` |  |
| `KindChanged` | `EventCallback<GupPaginationKind>` |  |
| `OnPageChange` | `EventCallback<int>` | Fires when the active page changes — receives the new page number. |
| `OnPrevClick` | `EventCallback<MouseEventArgs>` | Fires when the directional "Previous" link is clicked. |
| `OnNextClick` | `EventCallback<MouseEventArgs>` | Fires when the directional "Next" link is clicked. |

## Enums

### `GupPaginationKind`

Pagination layout variant. Mirrors the `kind` attribute on `<gup-pagination>`.

- `GupPaginationKind.Numbered` — Numbered pages with previous/next text buttons (default).
- `GupPaginationKind.Directional` — Two large prev/next links (no page numbers) — used for guided flows.

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Numbered default

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Pagination.razor -->
```razor
<GupPagination TotalPages="10" CurrentPage="3" />
```

### Two way binding bind currentpage

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Pagination.razor -->
```razor
<GupPagination TotalPages="25"
               @bind-CurrentPage="_boundPage"
               OnPageChange="HandlePageChange" />

<div style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; justify-content:center;">
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundPage = 1)">
        <ChildContent>Jump to first</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundPage = 13)">
        <ChildContent>Jump to middle</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundPage = 25)">
        <ChildContent>Jump to last</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
</div>

<p data-testid="bind-output" style="margin:0; text-align:center;">
    Bound page: <strong>@_boundPage</strong> &nbsp;·&nbsp;
    OnPageChange fired: <strong>@_pageChangeCount</strong> times
</p>
```

### Directional previous next

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Pagination.razor -->
```razor
<GupPagination Kind="GupPaginationKind.Directional"
               PrevLabel="Previous"
               PrevTitle="Rub your eyes and purify your heart – and prize above all else in the world those who love you and who wish you well"
               PrevLink="#prev"
               NextLabel="Next"
               NextTitle="But Art is a punitive sentence, not a birthright"
               NextLink="#next" />
```

### Directional previous only

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Pagination.razor -->
```razor
<GupPagination Kind="GupPaginationKind.Directional"
               PrevLabel="Previous"
               PrevTitle="Rub your eyes and purify your heart – and prize above all else in the world those who love you and who wish you well"
               PrevLink="#prev" />
```

### Directional next only

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Pagination.razor -->
```razor
<GupPagination Kind="GupPaginationKind.Directional"
               NextLabel="Next"
               NextTitle="But Art is a punitive sentence, not a birthright"
               NextLink="#next" />
```

### Directional onprevclick onnextclick events

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Pagination.razor -->
```razor
<GupPagination Kind="GupPaginationKind.Directional"
               PrevLabel="Previous"
               PrevTitle="Section 3 — accommodation"
               PrevLink="javascript:void(0)"
               NextLabel="Next"
               NextTitle="Section 5 — review & submit"
               NextLink="javascript:void(0)"
               OnPrevClick="@(_ => Log("Prev"))"
               OnNextClick="@(_ => Log("Next"))" />

<p data-testid="event-log" style="margin:0; text-align:center;">
    Last clicked: <strong>@_lastDirectionalClick</strong>
    &nbsp;·&nbsp; total: <strong>@_directionalClickCount</strong>
</p>
```

### Rtl arabic

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Pagination.razor -->
```razor
<GupPagination TotalPages="25" CurrentPage="6"
               PrevLabel="السابق" NextLabel="التالي" />

<GupPagination Kind="GupPaginationKind.Directional"
               PrevLabel="السابق"
               PrevTitle="القسم الثالث — الإقامة"
               PrevLink="#prev"
               NextLabel="التالي"
               NextTitle="القسم الخامس — المراجعة"
               NextLink="#next" />
```

### Numbered ellipsis truncation

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Pagination.razor -->
```razor
<div>
    <p style="margin:0 0 8px; color:#52525b;">Near start (page 2 of 25)</p>
    <GupPagination TotalPages="25" CurrentPage="2" />
</div>
<div>
    <p style="margin:0 0 8px; color:#52525b;">Mid-range (page 12 of 25)</p>
    <GupPagination TotalPages="25" CurrentPage="12" />
</div>
<div>
    <p style="margin:0 0 8px; color:#52525b;">Near end (page 23 of 25)</p>
    <GupPagination TotalPages="25" CurrentPage="23" />
</div>
```

# GupRadioButton

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupRadioButton.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/inputs/radio

Radio groups, horizontal and vertical.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-radio-button name="..." value="..." selected> Named slots: ChildContent (label text), Hint Events: OnChange (fires with this radio's value when it becomes selected) When nested inside a GupRadioButtonGroup, the group's @bind-Value drives selection.
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Name` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — |  |
| `Value` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — |  |
| `Selected` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `Disabled` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `Size` | `string` | `"m"` | — | Size of the radio button: `s`, `m` (default), or `l`. |
| `Required` | `bool` | — | — | Whether the radio button is required. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |
| `<Hint>` |  |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `OnChange` | `EventCallback<string>` |  |
| `OnFocus` | `EventCallback` | Fires when the radio button gains focus (matches `gup-focus`). |
| `OnBlur` | `EventCallback` | Fires when the radio button loses focus (matches `gup-blur`). |

## Cascading values consumed

- CascadedReadOnly (cascading name: "GupReadOnly")
- Group

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Default group

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Forms.razor -->
```razor
<GupRadioButtonGroup Label="Preferred contact method" Name="contact-method">
    <GupRadioButton Name="contact-method" Value="email">
        <ChildContent>Email</ChildContent>
        <Hint>We'll send updates to your inbox.</Hint>
    </GupRadioButton>
    <GupRadioButton Name="contact-method" Value="sms">
        <ChildContent>SMS</ChildContent>
        <Hint>We'll send a text to your phone.</Hint>
    </GupRadioButton>
    <GupRadioButton Name="contact-method" Value="none">
        <ChildContent>Do not contact</ChildContent>
    </GupRadioButton>
</GupRadioButtonGroup>
```

### With pre selected item

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Forms.razor -->
```razor
<GupRadioButtonGroup Label="Application type" Name="app-type">
    <GupRadioButton Name="app-type" Value="new" Selected="true">
        <ChildContent>New application</ChildContent>
        <Hint>Apply for the first time.</Hint>
    </GupRadioButton>
    <GupRadioButton Name="app-type" Value="renewal">
        <ChildContent>Renewal</ChildContent>
        <Hint>Renew an existing permit.</Hint>
    </GupRadioButton>
    <GupRadioButton Name="app-type" Value="replacement" Disabled="true">
        <ChildContent>Replacement (unavailable)</ChildContent>
    </GupRadioButton>
</GupRadioButtonGroup>
```

### Checkbox and radios

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ReadOnlyCascade.razor -->
```razor
<GupCheckbox Name="ro-check" @bind-Checked="_agreed"><ChildContent>I agree to the terms</ChildContent></GupCheckbox>

<div style="margin-top:16px;">
    <GupRadioButtonGroup Label="Preferred contact" Name="ro-radio" @bind-Value="_choice">
        <GupRadioButton Name="ro-radio" Value="email">
            <ChildContent>Email</ChildContent>
        </GupRadioButton>
        <GupRadioButton Name="ro-radio" Value="sms">
            <ChildContent>SMS</ChildContent>
        </GupRadioButton>
    </GupRadioButtonGroup>
</div>
```

# GupRadioButtonGroup

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupRadioButtonGroup.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/inputs/radio

Part of the Radio button component set — see the Radio button page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-radio-button-group label="..." name="..."> Two-way binding: @bind-Value (selected radio's value) Events: OnChange (new selected value)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Label` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — |  |
| `Name` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — |  |
| `Value` | `string?` | — | `@bind-Value` |  |
| `Required` | `bool` | `true` | — | Whether a selection is required. Mandatory by default; set to false to show "(optional)". |
| `ErrorMessage` | `string?` | — | — | Validation error message shown when `IsInvalid` is true. |
| `IsInvalid` | `bool` | — | — | Whether the group is in an invalid state. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<Hint>` | Optional hint slot rendered below the group label. |
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ValueChanged` | `EventCallback<string?>` |  |
| `OnChange` | `EventCallback<string?>` |  |
| `OnInvalid` | `EventCallback` | Fires when the group fails validation (matches `gup-invalid`). |

## Cascading values consumed

- CascadedLangId (cascading name: "GupLangId")

## Examples

```razor
        <Hint>We'll send a text to your phone.</Hint>
```

# GupReadOnlyRegion

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupReadOnlyRegion.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/read-only-cascade

Part of the Read-only cascade component set — see the Read-only cascade page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Marks a region as read-only. Does two things: 1. Cascades GupReadOnly, which the GUP field components honour natively (real disabled/readonly attributes, so keyboard and screen readers agree). 2. Blocks pointer interaction on the region itself, which catches bespoke markup a page hand-rolls outside the component library. The cascade is the real fix; the pointer block is the safety net.
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ReadOnly` | `bool` | — | — |  |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Gupreadonlyregion

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ReadOnlyCascade.razor -->
```razor
<p>
    Same cascade, plus <code>pointer-events:none</code> and
    <code>aria-disabled</code> on the wrapper — the safety net for
    hand-rolled markup. The raw input below is not a GUP component, so
    only the region blocks it.
</p>
<GupReadOnlyRegion ReadOnly="_readOnly">
    <GupFormList>
        <GupInputField Name="ro-region-field" Type="text" @bind-Value="_regionText">Inside the region</GupInputField>
    </GupFormList>
    <label style="display:block; margin-top:12px;">
        Plain HTML input (not a GUP component)
        <input type="text" @bind="_rawText" style="display:block; margin-top:4px; padding:8px;" />
    </label>
</GupReadOnlyRegion>
```

# GupScreenReaderText

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupScreenReaderText.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/screenreader-text

Part of the Screenreader text component set — see the Screenreader text page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-screenreader-text> Text that is visible only to assistive technologies (screen readers). Visually hidden via the "screenreader-text" pattern (clip + 1×1 absolute box) while remaining in the accessibility tree. Slots / RenderFragments: - ChildContent → the text/content to expose to screen readers (default slot) Parameters: - Text → plain-text alternative to ChildContent (use one or the other). - As   → tag name to render — "span" (default) or "div". - Role → optional ARIA role (e.g. "status", "alert") — useful when announcing dynamic updates via aria-live regions. - AriaLive → optional aria-live politeness ("polite" | "assertive" | "off"). Two-way binding: @bind-Text, @bind-As, @bind-Role, @bind-AriaLive Events: OnRendered (fires on every render — handy when the SR text is updated dynamically)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Text` | `string?` | — | `@bind-Text` | Plain-text content shown only to screen readers. Ignored when `ChildContent` is supplied. |
| `As` | `string` | `"span"` | `@bind-As` | Tag name to render — "span" (default) or "div". |
| `Role` | `string?` | — | `@bind-Role` | Optional ARIA role — e.g. "status" or "alert" for announce-on-update regions. |
| `AriaLive` | `string?` | — | `@bind-AriaLive` | Optional aria-live politeness ("polite", "assertive", or "off"). |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Rich content for the screenreader-only region — overrides `Text`. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TextChanged` | `EventCallback<string?>` |  |
| `AsChanged` | `EventCallback<string>` |  |
| `RoleChanged` | `EventCallback<string?>` |  |
| `AriaLiveChanged` | `EventCallback<string?>` |  |
| `OnRendered` | `EventCallback` | Fires after the component renders — useful when SR text is updated dynamically. |

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Text parameter no slot

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ScreenReaderText.razor -->
```razor
<p data-testid="text-param-example" style="margin:0;">
    Save
    <GupScreenReaderText Text="your application before continuing" />
</p>
```

### As div block level wrapper

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ScreenReaderText.razor -->
```razor
<ul style="margin:0; padding-left:20px;">
    <li>Form section 1
        <GupScreenReaderText As="div" Text="Personal details — three fields, all required" />
    </li>
    <li>Form section 2
        <GupScreenReaderText As="div" Text="Address — two fields, both required" />
    </li>
</ul>
```

### Default text only slot

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ScreenReaderText.razor -->
```razor
<p data-testid="default-example" style="margin:0;">
    The text below is only visible to screenreaders:
    <GupScreenReaderText>Screenreader text</GupScreenReaderText>
    Did you see it?
</p>
```

### Live region role arialive

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ScreenReaderText.razor -->
```razor
<div>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@AnnounceUpdate">
        <ChildContent>Announce update</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
</div>

<GupScreenReaderText Role="status"
                     AriaLive="polite"
                     Text="@_announcement" />

<p data-testid="announcement-output" style="margin:0;">
    <strong>Visible mirror (for the demo):</strong>
    "<span data-testid="announcement-value">@_announcement</span>"
    &nbsp;·&nbsp; announced
    <strong><span data-testid="announce-count">@_announceCount</span></strong> times
</p>
```

### Inspection helper temporarily reveal sr text

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ScreenReaderText.razor -->
```razor
<GupCheckbox Name="sr-reveal"
             @bind-Checked="_reveal">Reveal screenreader text (demo only)</GupCheckbox>

<div class="@(_reveal ? "sr-reveal" : "")">
    <p style="margin:0;">
        Submit
        <GupScreenReaderText Text="(this will permanently delete your draft)" />
    </p>
</div>
```

### Two way binding bind text

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../ScreenReaderText.razor -->
```razor
<GupInputField Name="sr-bound-text"
               @bind-Value="_boundText"
               Placeholder="Type here…">Screenreader text</GupInputField>

<p style="margin:0;">
    <strong>Visible:</strong> The button below has a hidden description —
    <GupScreenReaderText @bind-Text="_boundText" OnRendered="HandleRendered" />
</p>

<p data-testid="bind-output" style="margin:0;">
    <strong>Bound text:</strong> "<span data-testid="bind-value">@_boundText</span>"
    &nbsp;·&nbsp;
    <strong>OnRendered fired:</strong> <span data-testid="render-count">@_renderCount</span> times
</p>
```

# GupSearch

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupSearch.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/search

Search field with submit and clear affordances.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-search name="..." label="..." placeholder="..." value="..."> Pill-shaped search field with a clear-button (visible only when there is a value) and a trailing search-icon submit button. Mirrors the gov.om design-system component at design-system/components/search. Two-way binding: @bind-Value, @bind-Disabled Events: - OnValueChange → fires on every keystroke (input event); receives the new value - OnSearch      → fires when the search icon is clicked or Enter is pressed; receives the current value - OnClear       → fires when the × clear button is pressed - OnClick       → fires when the input is clicked (matches gup-click in the source component)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Name` | `string` | `"search"` | — | The name of the search input — used for the input id/name. |
| `Label` | `string` | `"Search"` | — | Accessible label for the search input (rendered as aria-label). |
| `Placeholder` | `string?` | — | — | Placeholder text shown when the field is empty. |
| `Value` | `string?` | — | `@bind-Value` | Current value of the search input. |
| `Disabled` | `bool` | — | `@bind-Disabled` | When true, the field and both buttons are visually disabled and non-interactive. |
| `SearchLabel` | `string` | `"Search"` | — | aria-label / title for the search submit button. |
| `ResetLabel` | `string` | `"Clear"` | — | aria-label / title for the clear button (× icon). |

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ValueChanged` | `EventCallback<string?>` |  |
| `DisabledChanged` | `EventCallback<bool>` |  |
| `OnValueChange` | `EventCallback<string?>` | Fires on every keystroke — receives the new value. |
| `OnSearch` | `EventCallback<string?>` | Fires when the user submits — clicking the search button or pressing Enter. Receives the current value. |
| `OnClear` | `EventCallback` | Fires when the × clear button is pressed. |
| `OnClick` | `EventCallback<MouseEventArgs>` | Fires when the input field is clicked. |

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Default

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Search.razor -->
```razor
<GupSearch Name="default" Label="Search" />
```

### With placeholder

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Search.razor -->
```razor
<GupSearch Name="placeholder"
           Label="Search services"
           Placeholder="Search for something…" />
```

### With initial value

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Search.razor -->
```razor
<GupSearch Name="prefilled"
           Label="Search"
           Value="what is the real meaning of life?" />
```

### Disabled

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Search.razor -->
```razor
<GupSearch Name="disabled"
           Label="Search"
           Placeholder="Search for something…"
           Disabled="true" />
```

### Two way binding bind value events

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Search.razor -->
```razor
<GupSearch Name="bound"
           Label="Search"
           Placeholder="Type something then press Enter or click 🔍"
           @bind-Value="_boundValue"
           OnValueChange="HandleValueChange"
           OnSearch="HandleSearch"
           OnClear="HandleClear"
           OnClick="HandleClick" />

<div style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundValue = "Hello world")">
        <ChildContent>Set to "Hello world"</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundValue = string.Empty)">
        <ChildContent>Clear externally</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
</div>

<div data-testid="bind-output" style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; margin:0;">
    <p style="margin:0;">
        <strong>Bound value:</strong>
        "<span data-testid="bind-value">@_boundValue</span>"
    </p>
    <p style="margin:0;">
        <strong>OnValueChange:</strong>
        <span data-testid="value-change-count">@_valueChangeCount</span> times
        &nbsp;·&nbsp;
        <strong>OnSearch:</strong>
        <span data-testid="search-count">@_searchCount</span> times
        &nbsp;·&nbsp;
        <strong>OnClear:</strong>
        <span data-testid="clear-count">@_clearCount</span> times
        &nbsp;·&nbsp;
        <strong>OnClick:</strong>
        <span data-testid="click-count">@_clickCount</span> times
    </p>
    <p style="margin:0;">
        <strong>Last submitted query:</strong>
        "<span data-testid="last-search">@_lastSearch</span>"
    </p>
</div>
```

### Two way binding bind disabled

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Search.razor -->
```razor
<GupSearch Name="bind-disabled"
           Label="Search"
           Placeholder="Search…"
           @bind-Disabled="_isDisabled"
           Value="Some preset query" />

<GupCheckbox Name="toggle-disabled"
             @bind-Checked="_isDisabled">Disable the search field</GupCheckbox>

<p style="margin:0;">
    Bound disabled state: <strong>@_isDisabled</strong>
</p>
```

### Rtl arabic

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Search.razor -->
```razor
<GupSearch Name="rtl"
           Label="بحث"
           Placeholder="ابحث عن شيء…"
           SearchLabel="بحث"
           ResetLabel="مسح" />
```

# GupSkipLink

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupSkipLink.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/skip-link

Keyboard-only link that jumps past the header to main content.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-skip-link href="#main-content"> Anchor that lets keyboard users bypass the header navigation and jump straight to the main content. Visually hidden until it receives focus (first Tab press). The target element must exist on the page — e.g. <main id="main-content" tabindex="-1">.
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Href` | `string` | `"#main-content"` | — | Fragment link (including `#`) to the main content block, e.g. `#main-content`. An element with that id must exist on the page, otherwise the link does nothing. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Link text. Use phrasing content only — avoid nesting links or buttons. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### From the SkipLink page template

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../SkipLink.razor -->
```razor

```

# GupSpinner

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupSpinner.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/spinner

Indeterminate loading indicator in several sizes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-spinner size="s|m|l|xl"> — accessible loading indicator. Renders the gov.om brand spinner SVG with a continuous rotation animation. Sizes: s=16px, m=24px (default), l=40px, xl=64px. Pass Pixels to override. Legacy small/medium/large values are still accepted for backward compatibility. Set LabelHidden to keep the label for screen-readers only.
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Size` | `string` | `"m"` | — | Spinner size: `s`, `m` (default), `l`, or `xl`. Legacy `small`/`medium`/`large` values are also accepted. |
| `Pixels` | `int?` | — | — | Override the size with an explicit pixel value. |
| `Label` | `string` | `"Loading..."` | — | Optional label displayed below the spinner (and read by screen-readers). Default: "Loading...". |
| `Text` | `string?` | — | — | Optional visible text alongside the spinner. Suppressed when `LabelHidden` is true. |
| `LabelHidden` | `bool` | — | — | If true, the label/text is hidden visually and available only to screen-readers (matches `label-hidden`). |

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Small (16px)

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Spinner.razor -->
```razor
<GupSpinner Size="small" />
```

### Medium · default (24px)

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Spinner.razor -->
```razor
<GupSpinner />
```

### Large (40px)

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Spinner.razor -->
```razor
<GupSpinner Size="large" />
```

### Inline text label

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Spinner.razor -->
```razor
<GupSpinner Text="Loading..." />
```

### Large with text · custom ARIA label

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Spinner.razor -->
```razor
<GupSpinner Size="large"
            Text="Submitting your application..."
            Label="Submitting your application, please wait" />
```

### Centered loading panel

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Spinner.razor -->
```razor
<GupSpinner Size="large" Text="Fetching data..." />
```

### On dark canvas

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Spinner.razor -->
```razor
<GupSpinner Size="large" Text="Loading..." />
```

### Inside a button

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Spinner.razor -->
```razor
<GupButton Appearance="@GupButtonAppearance.Primary" Kind="@GupButtonKind.Button">
  <ChildContent>
    <GupTrack Direction="horizontal" Gap="2" VerticalAlignment="center">
      <GupSpinner Size="small" Label="Saving" />
      <span>Saving…</span>
    </GupTrack>
  </ChildContent>
</GupButton>
```

# GupStepper

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupStepper.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/stepper

The wizard progress indicator, with stepper items in complete, current and upcoming states.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-stepper static-mode wizard-mode continued toggle-all-displayed> Container for gup-stepper-item elements.
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ToggleAllDisplayed` | `bool` | — | — | Show a button that toggles all steps open/closed. Ignored in wizard or static mode. |
| `ShowAllLabel` | `string` | `"Show all steps"` | — | Label for the "show all" toggle button. |
| `HideAllLabel` | `string` | `"Hide all steps"` | — | Label for the "hide all" toggle button. |
| `WizardMode` | `bool` | — | — | Wizard mode — all steps open and toggle buttons hidden. |
| `StaticMode` | `bool` | — | — | Static (read-only) mode — toggle functionality is unavailable. |
| `Continued` | `bool` | — | — | Whether the stepper appears as continuing from a non-first item. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

# GupStepperItem

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupStepperItem.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/stepper

Part of the Stepper component set — see the Stepper page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-stepper-item step-number="1" step-type="default|done|selected|and" open wizard-mode static-mode> Named slot: LabelContent (or the plain-text Label attribute) Default slot: ChildContent (collapsible content of the step)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Label` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — | The label of the step (used when the Label slot is not provided). |
| `StepNumber` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — | The number of the step. |
| `StepType` | `string` | `"default"` | — | Type of the step marker: `default`, `done`, `selected`, or `and`. |
| `LabelAnd` | `string` | `"and"` | — | Translatable label for the "and" indicator. |
| `WizardMode` | `bool` | — | — | Whether the stepper item is in wizard mode. |
| `StaticMode` | `bool` | — | — | Whether the step is static and not interactive (auto-set when inside a static-mode gup-stepper). |
| `Open` | `bool` | — | — | Whether the step is open. |
| `LabelShow` | `string` | `"Show"` | — | Translatable label for the accordion "Show" indicator. |
| `LabelHide` | `string` | `"Hide"` | — | Translatable label for the accordion "Hide" indicator. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<LabelContent>` | The label content slot. Takes precedence over the Label attribute. |
| `<ChildContent>` | The collapsible content of the step. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Static mode all step types

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Feedback.razor -->
```razor
<GupStepper StaticMode="true">
  <GupStepperItem StepNumber="1" StepType="done">
    <LabelContent>Personal details</LabelContent>
  </GupStepperItem>
  <GupStepperItem StepNumber="2" StepType="done">
    <LabelContent>Contact information</LabelContent>
  </GupStepperItem>
  <GupStepperItem StepNumber="3" StepType="selected">
    <LabelContent>Document upload</LabelContent>
  </GupStepperItem>
  <GupStepperItem StepNumber="4" StepType="default">
    <LabelContent>Review &amp; submit</LabelContent>
  </GupStepperItem>
  <GupStepperItem StepNumber="5" StepType="default">
    <LabelContent>Confirmation</LabelContent>
  </GupStepperItem>
</GupStepper>
```

### Wizard mode

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../StepperDemo.razor -->
```razor
<GupStepper WizardMode="true">
  <GupStepperItem StepNumber="1" Label="Business details" StepType="complete" WizardMode="true" />
  <GupStepperItem StepNumber="2" Label="Premises" StepType="current" WizardMode="true" Open="true" />
  <GupStepperItem StepNumber="3" Label="Documents" WizardMode="true" />
  <GupStepperItem StepNumber="4" Label="Review and submit" WizardMode="true" />
</GupStepper>
```

### Static mode

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../StepperDemo.razor -->
```razor
<GupStepper StaticMode="true">
  <GupStepperItem StepNumber="1" Label="Submitted" StepType="complete" StaticMode="true" />
  <GupStepperItem StepNumber="2" Label="Under review" StepType="current" StaticMode="true" />
  <GupStepperItem StepNumber="3" Label="Decision" StaticMode="true" />
</GupStepper>
```

### Step types close up

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Feedback.razor -->
```razor
<GupTrack Direction="vertical" Gap="5">
  <div>
    <div class="demo-card-label" style="margin-bottom:8px;">done</div>
    <GupStepper StaticMode="true">
      <GupStepperItem StepNumber="1" StepType="done">
        <LabelContent>Completed step</LabelContent>
      </GupStepperItem>
    </GupStepper>
  </div>
  <div>
    <div class="demo-card-label" style="margin-bottom:8px;">selected</div>
    <GupStepper StaticMode="true">
      <GupStepperItem StepNumber="2" StepType="selected">
        <LabelContent>Current step</LabelContent>
      </GupStepperItem>
    </GupStepper>
  </div>
  <div>
    <div class="demo-card-label" style="margin-bottom:8px;">default</div>
    <GupStepper StaticMode="true">
      <GupStepperItem StepNumber="3" StepType="default">
        <LabelContent>Upcoming step</LabelContent>
      </GupStepperItem>
    </GupStepper>
  </div>
</GupTrack>
```

# GupTab

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupTab.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/tabs

Part of the Tabs component set — see the Tabs page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-tab disabled selected> A single tab button. When nested inside a GupTabs, the parent's SelectedIndex drives the selected state — clicking the tab asks the parent to switch. Slots: - ChildContent  → button label - IconStart     → icon shown before the label - IconEnd       → icon shown after the label Events: - OnClick → fires when this tab is clicked (disabled tabs do not fire it)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Disabled` | `bool` | — | — | Whether the tab is disabled. Disabled tabs cannot be selected via click. |
| `Selected` | `bool` | — | — | Initial selected state. When nested inside a `GupTabs` this only acts as a pre-selection hint — the parent owns the runtime selected state. |
| `Label` | `string?` | — | — | Plain-text label, used as the bold sizing twin for the default/toggle appearances. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |
| `<IconStart>` |  |
| `<IconEnd>` |  |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `OnClick` | `EventCallback` | Fires when the tab is clicked (disabled tabs do not fire). |

## Cascading values consumed

- Tabs

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Default appearance

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Tabs.razor -->
```razor
<GupTabs Appearance="GupTabsAppearance.Default">
    <GupTabsNavigation>
        <GupTab Label="First tab"><ChildContent>First tab</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Second tab"><ChildContent>Second tab</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Third tab"><ChildContent>Third tab</ChildContent></GupTab>
    </GupTabsNavigation>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Panel for first tab</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Panel for second tab</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Panel for third tab</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
</GupTabs>
```

### Default full width

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Tabs.razor -->
```razor
<GupTabs Appearance="GupTabsAppearance.Default" IsFullWidth="true">
    <GupTabsNavigation>
        <GupTab Label="Overview"><ChildContent>Overview</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Details"><ChildContent>Details</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="History"><ChildContent>History</ChildContent></GupTab>
    </GupTabsNavigation>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Service overview content.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Detailed service description.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Service request history.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
</GupTabs>
```

### Toggle appearance

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Tabs.razor -->
```razor
<GupTabs Appearance="GupTabsAppearance.Toggle">
    <GupTabsNavigation>
        <GupTab Label="Day"><ChildContent>Day</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Week"><ChildContent>Week</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Month"><ChildContent>Month</ChildContent></GupTab>
    </GupTabsNavigation>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Showing today's activity.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Showing this week's activity.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Showing this month's activity.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
</GupTabs>
```

### Toggle full width

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Tabs.razor -->
```razor
<GupTabs Appearance="GupTabsAppearance.Toggle" IsFullWidth="true">
    <GupTabsNavigation>
        <GupTab Label="Cards"><ChildContent>Cards</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="List"><ChildContent>List</ChildContent></GupTab>
    </GupTabsNavigation>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Card layout selected.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>List layout selected.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
</GupTabs>
```

### Vertical appearance

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Tabs.razor -->
```razor
<GupTabs Appearance="GupTabsAppearance.Vertical">
    <GupTabsNavigation>
        <GupTab Label="Profile"><ChildContent>Profile</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Notifications"><ChildContent>Notifications</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Security"><ChildContent>Security</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Privacy"><ChildContent>Privacy</ChildContent></GupTab>
    </GupTabsNavigation>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Profile settings panel.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Notification settings panel.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Security settings panel.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Privacy settings panel.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
</GupTabs>
```

### Disabled tab pre selection

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Tabs.razor -->
```razor
<GupTabs Appearance="GupTabsAppearance.Default">
    <GupTabsNavigation>
        <GupTab Label="Step 1"><ChildContent>Step 1</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Step 2" Selected="true"><ChildContent>Step 2 (preselected)</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Step 3" Disabled="true"><ChildContent>Step 3 (disabled)</ChildContent></GupTab>
    </GupTabsNavigation>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Panel one.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Panel two — this opens by default.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Panel three.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
</GupTabs>
```

### Two way binding bind selectedindex events

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Tabs.razor -->
```razor
<GupTabs Appearance="GupTabsAppearance.Default"
         @bind-SelectedIndex="_boundIndex"
         OnSelectedIndexChange="HandleIndexChange">
    <GupTabsNavigation>
        <GupTab Label="Tab A"><ChildContent>Tab A</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Tab B"><ChildContent>Tab B</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Tab C"><ChildContent>Tab C</ChildContent></GupTab>
    </GupTabsNavigation>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Content for tab A.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Content for tab B.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Content for tab C.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
</GupTabs>

<div style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
    <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundIndex = 0)">
        <ChildContent>Select A</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundIndex = 1)">
        <ChildContent>Select B</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundIndex = 2)">
        <ChildContent>Select C</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
</div>

<div data-testid="bind-output" style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; margin:0;">
    <p style="margin:0;">
        <strong>Bound index:</strong>
        <span data-testid="bind-index">@_boundIndex</span>
    </p>
    <p style="margin:0;">
        <strong>OnSelectedIndexChange:</strong>
        fired <span data-testid="change-count">@_indexChangeCount</span> times
        &nbsp;·&nbsp;
        <strong>Last index:</strong>
        <span data-testid="last-index">@_lastIndex</span>
    </p>
</div>
```

### With start end icons

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Tabs.razor -->
```razor
<GupTabs Appearance="GupTabsAppearance.Default">
    <GupTabsNavigation>
        <GupTab Label="Inbox">
            <IconStart><GupIcon IconName="inbox" Width="20" Height="20" /></IconStart>
            <ChildContent>Inbox</ChildContent>
        </GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Drafts">
            <IconStart><GupIcon IconName="edit_document" Width="20" Height="20" /></IconStart>
            <ChildContent>Drafts</ChildContent>
        </GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Sent">
            <IconStart><GupIcon IconName="send" Width="20" Height="20" /></IconStart>
            <ChildContent>Sent</ChildContent>
        </GupTab>
    </GupTabsNavigation>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>You have 3 unread messages.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>2 drafts saved.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>No sent messages today.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
</GupTabs>
```

# GupTabPanel

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupTabPanel.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/tabs

Part of the Tabs component set — see the Tabs page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-tab-panel> A single content panel inside a GupTabs. When nested inside a GupTabs the parent's SelectedIndex drives the hidden state. Slot — ChildContent: panel content.
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Cascading values consumed

- Tabs

# GupTable

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupTable.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/table-cell

Part of the Table & table cell component set — see the Table & table cell page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-table>
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Responsive` | `bool` | — | — | When true, the table collapses into stacked cards below the mobile breakpoint (each row becomes a bordered card, each cell stacks with its `Label` shown inline). Use for data tables that would otherwise overflow narrow screens. Default: false (classic table). |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Row headers key value summary

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../DataDisplay.razor -->
```razor
<GupTable>
  <GupTableRow>
    <GupTableCell Type="rowheader">Applicant name</GupTableCell>
    <GupTableCell>Mohammed Al Rashdi</GupTableCell>
  </GupTableRow>
  <GupTableRow>
    <GupTableCell Type="rowheader">Civil ID</GupTableCell>
    <GupTableCell>78345612</GupTableCell>
  </GupTableRow>
  <GupTableRow>
    <GupTableCell Type="rowheader">Application date</GupTableCell>
    <GupTableCell>09 April 2026</GupTableCell>
  </GupTableRow>
  <GupTableRow>
    <GupTableCell Type="rowheader">Status</GupTableCell>
    <GupTableCell>Under review</GupTableCell>
  </GupTableRow>
  <GupTableRow>
    <GupTableCell Type="rowheader">Reference number</GupTableCell>
    <GupTableCell>GOV-2026-004412</GupTableCell>
  </GupTableRow>

</GupTable>
```

# GupTableCell

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupTableCell.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/table-cell

Part of the Table & table cell component set — see the Table & table cell page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-table-cell type="header|rowheader|data"> type="rowheader" renders as <th scope="row">, "header" (alias "head") as <th scope="col">, default as <td>
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Type` | `string` | `"data"` | — |  |
| `Label` | `string?` | — | — | Field label shown inline above the cell value when the parent `GupTable` is in `Responsive` (stacked-card) mode on small screens. Ignored in the classic table layout. Typically set to the column header text (e.g. "Terms", "Status"). |
| `AdditionalAttributes` | `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object>?` | — | — |  |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Basic table

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../TableCellDemo.razor -->

```razor
  <GupTableRow>

    <GupTableCell Type="header">Service</GupTableCell>
    <GupTableCell Type="header">Status</GupTableCell>
  </GupTableRow>
  <GupTableRow>
    <GupTableCell>OM-2026-4471</GupTableCell>
    <GupTableCell>Licence renewal</GupTableCell>
    <GupTableCell>Approved</GupTableCell>
  </GupTableRow>
  <GupTableRow>
    <GupTableCell>OM-2026-4472</GupTableCell>
    <GupTableCell>New registration</GupTableCell>
    <GupTableCell>Under review</GupTableCell>
  </GupTableRow>
</GupTable>
```

### Default search and pagination

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../DataTable.razor -->
```razor
<GupDataTable Items="Applications"
              SearchTextSelector="SearchText"
              TableTitle="Applications"
              Description="This is a short description"
              Columns="ApplicationColumns"
              ItemsPerPage="6"
              TotalItems="Applications.Count"
              @bind-SearchValue="_defaultSearch"
              @bind-CurrentPage="_defaultPage"
              @bind-ResultsCount="_defaultResults"
              ShowFilters="false">
    <RowTemplate Context="app">
        <GupTableRow>
            <GupTableCell Label="Number">@app.Number</GupTableCell>
            <GupTableCell Label="Type">@app.Type</GupTableCell>
            <GupTableCell Label="Start date">@app.StartDate</GupTableCell>
            <GupTableCell Label="End date">@app.EndDate</GupTableCell>
            <GupTableCell Label="Status">
                <GupBadgeChip Appearance="@app.StatusAppearance">@app.Status</GupBadgeChip>
            </GupTableCell>
        </GupTableRow>
    </RowTemplate>
</GupDataTable>
```

### Search only

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../DataTable.razor -->
```razor
<GupDataTable Items="Applications"
              SearchTextSelector="SearchText"
              SearchPlaceholder="Search applications"
              Columns="ApplicationColumns"
              ItemsPerPage="10"
              TotalItems="Applications.Count"
              ShowFilters="false"
              @bind-SearchValue="_searchOnlySearch"
              @bind-CurrentPage="_searchOnlyPage"
              @bind-ResultsCount="_searchOnlyResults"
              OnSearch="@(term => Log($"Search: {term}"))">
    <RowTemplate Context="app">
        <GupTableRow>
            <GupTableCell Label="Number">@app.Number</GupTableCell>
            <GupTableCell Label="Type">@app.Type</GupTableCell>
            <GupTableCell Label="Start date">@app.StartDate</GupTableCell>
            <GupTableCell Label="End date">@app.EndDate</GupTableCell>
            <GupTableCell Label="Status">
                <GupBadgeChip Appearance="@app.StatusAppearance">@app.Status</GupBadgeChip>
            </GupTableCell>
        </GupTableRow>
    </RowTemplate>
</GupDataTable>
```

# GupTabs

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupTabs.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/tabs

Default, toggle and vertical appearances, with tab panels and tabs navigation.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-tabs appearance="default|toggle|vertical" is-full-width> A wrapper for a tab group. Owns the index of the currently selected tab and coordinates GupTab (button) children with GupTabPanel (content) children. Slot — ChildContent expects exactly one <GupTabsNavigation> followed by one or more <GupTabPanel> elements (matching the gov.om gup-tabs Lit component). Two-way binding: @bind-SelectedIndex Events: OnSelectedIndexChange (new index)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Appearance` | `GupTabsAppearance` | `GupTabsAppearance.Default` | — | Visual appearance of the tab group. |
| `IsFullWidth` | `bool` | — | — | Whether the tabs strip should fill the available width. Only relevant when `Appearance` is `Default` or `Toggle`. |
| `SelectedIndex` | `int` | — | `@bind-SelectedIndex` | Index of the currently selected tab. |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SelectedIndexChanged` | `EventCallback<int>` |  |
| `OnSelectedIndexChange` | `EventCallback<int>` | Fires whenever the selected tab index changes. |

## Enums

### `GupTabsAppearance`

Visual appearance for `GupTabs`. Mirrors the `appearance` attribute on `<gup-tabs>`.

- `GupTabsAppearance.Default` — Underlined active tab on a horizontal strip (default).
- `GupTabsAppearance.Toggle` — Pill-shaped toggle group with a rounded background.
- `GupTabsAppearance.Vertical` — Stacked vertical list of tabs with a leading active indicator.

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Default appearance

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Tabs.razor -->
```razor
<GupTabs Appearance="GupTabsAppearance.Default">
    <GupTabsNavigation>
        <GupTab Label="First tab"><ChildContent>First tab</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Second tab"><ChildContent>Second tab</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Third tab"><ChildContent>Third tab</ChildContent></GupTab>
    </GupTabsNavigation>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Panel for first tab</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Panel for second tab</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Panel for third tab</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
</GupTabs>
```

### Default full width

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Tabs.razor -->
```razor
<GupTabs Appearance="GupTabsAppearance.Default" IsFullWidth="true">
    <GupTabsNavigation>
        <GupTab Label="Overview"><ChildContent>Overview</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Details"><ChildContent>Details</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="History"><ChildContent>History</ChildContent></GupTab>
    </GupTabsNavigation>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Service overview content.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Detailed service description.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Service request history.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
</GupTabs>
```

### Toggle appearance

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Tabs.razor -->
```razor
<GupTabs Appearance="GupTabsAppearance.Toggle">
    <GupTabsNavigation>
        <GupTab Label="Day"><ChildContent>Day</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Week"><ChildContent>Week</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Month"><ChildContent>Month</ChildContent></GupTab>
    </GupTabsNavigation>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Showing today's activity.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Showing this week's activity.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Showing this month's activity.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
</GupTabs>
```

### Toggle full width

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Tabs.razor -->
```razor
<GupTabs Appearance="GupTabsAppearance.Toggle" IsFullWidth="true">
    <GupTabsNavigation>
        <GupTab Label="Cards"><ChildContent>Cards</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="List"><ChildContent>List</ChildContent></GupTab>
    </GupTabsNavigation>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Card layout selected.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>List layout selected.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
</GupTabs>
```

### Vertical appearance

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Tabs.razor -->
```razor
<GupTabs Appearance="GupTabsAppearance.Vertical">
    <GupTabsNavigation>
        <GupTab Label="Profile"><ChildContent>Profile</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Notifications"><ChildContent>Notifications</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Security"><ChildContent>Security</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Privacy"><ChildContent>Privacy</ChildContent></GupTab>
    </GupTabsNavigation>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Profile settings panel.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Notification settings panel.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Security settings panel.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Privacy settings panel.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
</GupTabs>
```

### Disabled tab pre selection

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Tabs.razor -->
```razor
<GupTabs Appearance="GupTabsAppearance.Default">
    <GupTabsNavigation>
        <GupTab Label="Step 1"><ChildContent>Step 1</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Step 2" Selected="true"><ChildContent>Step 2 (preselected)</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Step 3" Disabled="true"><ChildContent>Step 3 (disabled)</ChildContent></GupTab>
    </GupTabsNavigation>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Panel one.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Panel two — this opens by default.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Panel three.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
</GupTabs>
```

### Two way binding bind selectedindex events

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Tabs.razor -->
```razor
<GupTabs Appearance="GupTabsAppearance.Default"
         @bind-SelectedIndex="_boundIndex"
         OnSelectedIndexChange="HandleIndexChange">
    <GupTabsNavigation>
        <GupTab Label="Tab A"><ChildContent>Tab A</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Tab B"><ChildContent>Tab B</ChildContent></GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Tab C"><ChildContent>Tab C</ChildContent></GupTab>
    </GupTabsNavigation>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Content for tab A.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Content for tab B.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Content for tab C.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
</GupTabs>

<div style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
    <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundIndex = 0)">
        <ChildContent>Select A</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundIndex = 1)">
        <ChildContent>Select B</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
    <GupButton Appearance="GupButtonAppearance.Secondary" Kind="GupButtonKind.Button"
               OnClick="@(() => _boundIndex = 2)">
        <ChildContent>Select C</ChildContent>
    </GupButton>
</div>

<div data-testid="bind-output" style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; margin:0;">
    <p style="margin:0;">
        <strong>Bound index:</strong>
        <span data-testid="bind-index">@_boundIndex</span>
    </p>
    <p style="margin:0;">
        <strong>OnSelectedIndexChange:</strong>
        fired <span data-testid="change-count">@_indexChangeCount</span> times
        &nbsp;·&nbsp;
        <strong>Last index:</strong>
        <span data-testid="last-index">@_lastIndex</span>
    </p>
</div>
```

### With start end icons

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Tabs.razor -->
```razor
<GupTabs Appearance="GupTabsAppearance.Default">
    <GupTabsNavigation>
        <GupTab Label="Inbox">
            <IconStart><GupIcon IconName="inbox" Width="20" Height="20" /></IconStart>
            <ChildContent>Inbox</ChildContent>
        </GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Drafts">
            <IconStart><GupIcon IconName="edit_document" Width="20" Height="20" /></IconStart>
            <ChildContent>Drafts</ChildContent>
        </GupTab>
        <GupTab Label="Sent">
            <IconStart><GupIcon IconName="send" Width="20" Height="20" /></IconStart>
            <ChildContent>Sent</ChildContent>
        </GupTab>
    </GupTabsNavigation>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>You have 3 unread messages.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>2 drafts saved.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>No sent messages today.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
</GupTabs>
```

# GupTabsNavigation

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupTabsNavigation.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/tabs

Part of the Tabs component set — see the Tabs page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-tabs-navigation> A wrapper for the tab buttons inside a GupTabs. Reads appearance/full-width from the parent so it can apply the matching layout. Slot — ChildContent: GupTab buttons.
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Cascading values consumed

- Tabs

## Examples

```razor
        <GupTab Label="Month"><ChildContent>Month</ChildContent></GupTab>
    </GupTabsNavigation>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Showing today's activity.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Showing this week's activity.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
    <GupTabPanel><ChildContent>Showing this month's activity.</ChildContent></GupTabPanel>
</GupTabs>
```

# GupTextarea

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupTextarea.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/inputs/textarea

Part of the Textarea field component set — see the Textarea field page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-textarea-field name="..." rows="...">Label</gup-textarea-field> Two-way binding: @bind-Value Events: OnValueChange (fires on every input), OnChange (fires on change/blur)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Name` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — |  |
| `Placeholder` | `string?` | — | — |  |
| `Value` | `string?` | — | `@bind-Value` |  |
| `Disabled` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `Readonly` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `Required` | `bool` | `true` | — |  |
| `Rows` | `int` | `4` | — |  |
| `Minlength` | `int?` | — | — |  |
| `Maxlength` | `int?` | — | — |  |
| `ErrorMessage` | `string?` | — | — |  |
| `IsInvalid` | `bool` | — | — |  |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |
| `<HintContent>` |  |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ValueChanged` | `EventCallback<string?>` |  |
| `OnValueChange` | `EventCallback<string?>` | Fires whenever the textarea value changes (on every input event). |
| `OnChange` | `EventCallback<string?>` | Fires when the textarea value changes and loses focus. |
| `OnKeyPress` | `EventCallback<KeyboardEventArgs>` | Fires when a key is pressed inside the textarea. |
| `OnInvalid` | `EventCallback` | Fires when the textarea enters the invalid state (matches `gup-invalid`). |

## Cascading values consumed

- CascadedReadOnly (cascading name: "GupReadOnly")
- CascadedLangId (cascading name: "GupLangId")

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Default

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Textarea.razor -->
```razor
<GupFormList>
    <GupTextarea Name="msg-default">Your message</GupTextarea>
</GupFormList>
```

### With placeholder

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Textarea.razor -->
```razor

    <GupTextarea Name="msg-placeholder" Placeholder="Type your message here...">Your message</GupTextarea>
</GupFormList>
```

### Pre-filled

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Textarea.razor -->
```razor
<GupFormList>
    <GupTextarea Name="msg-value" Value="This is some pre-filled message text.">Your message</GupTextarea>
</GupFormList>
```

### Read-only

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Textarea.razor -->
```razor

    <GupTextarea Name="msg-readonly" Value="This message cannot be edited." Readonly="true">Read-only message</GupTextarea>
</GupFormList>
```

### Disabled

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Textarea.razor -->
```razor

    <GupTextarea Name="msg-disabled" Disabled="true">Disabled message</GupTextarea>
</GupFormList>
```

### 2 rows

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Textarea.razor -->
```razor
<GupFormList>
    <GupTextarea Name="msg-rows-2" Rows="2">Short message</GupTextarea>
</GupFormList>
```

### 4 rows (default)

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Textarea.razor -->
```razor
<GupFormList>
    <GupTextarea Name="msg-rows-4" Rows="4">Standard message</GupTextarea>
</GupFormList>
```

### 10 rows

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Textarea.razor -->
```razor
<GupFormList>
    <GupTextarea Name="msg-rows-10" Rows="10">Long message</GupTextarea>
</GupFormList>
```

# GupToast

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupToast.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/toasts

Part of the Toast & toast container component set — see the Toast & toast container page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-toast severity="neutral|positive|negative|warning" close-label="..."> ChildContent is the message body. OnRemove fires when the close button is clicked.
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Severity` | `string` | `"neutral"` | — |  |
| `CloseLabel` | `string` | `"Close"` | — |  |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `OnRemove` | `EventCallback` |  |

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### From the Toasts page template

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Toasts.razor -->
```razor
<GupToast Severity="neutral">
            This is a toast message slave desk north official prevent finish tightly mean suppose attack gravity breathing production was her test finally everybody
          </GupToast>
```

### From the Toasts page template

<!-- from GUPBlazorDemo/Components/Pages/.../Toasts.razor -->
```razor

            Your changes have been saved successfully.
          </GupToast>
```

# GupToastContainer

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupToastContainer.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/toasts

Part of the Toast & toast container component set — see the Toast & toast container page for how it composes.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-toast-container>. Mount once (typically in MainLayout) and call ToastService.Show(...) from any page to push a toast. Also accepts ChildContent for static <GupToast> entries and supports @ref-based AddToast() for backward compatibility.
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

# GupToggle

> GUPBlazor 0.3.4 — Blazor implementation of the gov.om (Government Unified Platform) design system.
> Source: `GUPBlazor/Components/GupToggle.razor`
> Live demo: https://gupdesign.sme.gov.om/demo/inputs/toggle

On/off switch with label and hint.

## Upstream mapping

```text
Equivalent of <gup-toggle name="..." checked disabled readonly knob-location="before|after"> Two-way binding: @bind-Checked Events: OnChange (new checked state)
```

## Import

```razor
@using GUPBlazor.Components
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Bindable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Name` | `string` | `"" (empty)` | — |  |
| `Checked` | `bool` | — | `@bind-Checked` |  |
| `Disabled` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `Readonly` | `bool` | — | — |  |
| `KnobLocation` | `string` | `"before"` | — | "before" (default) renders knob before the text, "after" renders knob after the text. |
| `Id` | `string?` | — | — |  |

## Slots (RenderFragment)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ChildContent>` | Default content. |
| `<Hint>` |  |

> Named slots are child elements, not attributes. When you use any named slot, wrap the default content in `<ChildContent>` explicitly.

## Events

| Event | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `CheckedChanged` | `EventCallback<bool>` |  |
| `OnChange` | `EventCallback<bool>` | Fires whenever the toggle is changed by the user. |

## Examples

Verbatim from the demo pages — this is the markup that renders in the live demo.

### Unchecked

```razor
    <ChildContent>Default</ChildContent>
</GupToggle>
```


### Knob after

```razor
    <ChildContent>Knob after label</ChildContent>
</GupToggle>
```

### Unchecked + disabled

